61727.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD33 versus CD56 gated on blasts shows the abnormal population (green) to be CD56-positive and predominantly CD33-negative to dim. A separate population of residual normal myeloid blasts (red) expresses CD33 without CD56. CD56 expression on CD33-negative/dim blasts provides an internal contrast with normal myeloblasts and is compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, noting that partial dim CD33 can be seen in BPDCN. Integration with CD4 and bright CD123/HLA-DR expression and negative MPO, CD34 and lineage markers is required.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with aberrant CD56
ddx.vs: AML blasts with CD56 usually retain bright CD33 and/or CD13, CD34 or CD117, unlike these CD33-negative/dim blasts.
NK neoplasms are CD56+/CD33- but express CD2, CD7, cytoplasmic CD3-epsilon and cytotoxic molecules and lack bright CD123 and CD4.

61663.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中央可見兩個相鄰的大型巨核細胞，核高度分葉、摺疊，胞質豐富，周圍為密集的紅血球系與顆粒球系前驅細胞，是 PV 中大型、多形性巨核細胞聚集的典型表現。
features: Adjacent large megakaryocytes with hyperlobated, folded nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes pleomorphic in size, forming a small loose cluster
Surrounding hypercellular marrow with erythroid islands and granulocytic precursors
Dilated sinusoidal spaces with extravasated red cells
No increased blasts or dysplastic micromegakaryocytes identified
61663.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows hypercellular marrow with trilineage hyperplasia. Megakaryocytes are enlarged and loosely clustered, with abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobulated nuclei, without small hypolobated or bizarre cloud-like forms. The background shows abundant erythroid and maturing granulocytic precursors without an increase in blasts. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm and support polycythemia vera in the appropriate clinical and molecular setting.

ddx.vs: ET shows similar large hyperlobated megakaryocytes but on a normocellular background without erythroid and granulocytic proliferation.
PMF megakaryocytes have high N:C ratio, hyperchromatic, clumped cloud-like nuclei and form dense clusters, often with reticulin fibrosis.
MDS features small hypolobated or separated-lobe megakaryocytes rather than large mature hyperlobated forms.

exam.answer_en: Polycythemia vera — enlarged hyperlobated megakaryocytes in loose clusters within hypercellular marrow with erythroid and granulocytic hyperplasia
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央兩顆相鄰大型巨核細胞問「核型態？有無發育不良？」答核過度分葉摺疊、胞質成熟，無 micromegakaryocyte，支持 MPN（PV）而非 MDS。
PV 診斷需結合 CBC：Hb/Hct 升高，WHO 5th 條件為 Hb >16.5/16.0 g/dL 或 Hct >49%/48%（男/女），加骨髓全髓增生與 JAK2 突變，次要條件 EPO 低。
PV 血栓風險分層：年齡 ≥60 歲或有血栓史為高風險；所有病人放血維持 Hct <45% 並用低劑量 aspirin。
缺鐵可掩蓋 PV（masked PV）：Hb 未達門檻但 RBC 數高、MCV 低，需注意 JAK2 檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 MDS 的巨核細胞異常：MDS 常見小型低分葉或核分離（separated lobes）的 dysplastic megakaryocytes 且細胞多有發育不良；本圖巨核細胞大而過度分葉，屬 MPN 型態。

quiz.q: 圖中央兩顆巨核細胞核過度分葉、胞質豐富、無小型發育不良形態，較支持 MPN 還是 MDS？若病人 Hct 升高，最可能是哪個疾病？
quiz.a: MPN；polycythemia vera（需 JAK2 突變與 EPO 低佐證）。

61599.recognize_zh: CD79a 染色中腫瘤細胞大多陰性或僅有極淡的細胞質染色，只有中央一個細胞呈強烈環狀陽性（內部對照）；漿母細胞淋巴瘤常見 CD79a 弱陽性、部分陽性或陰性，所以 B 細胞標記缺失不可據以排除 B 細胞來源。
features: Monotonous sheet of tumor cells with round nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Tumor cells negative to at most faint, weak cytoplasmic CD79a staining
Single strongly positive cell with ring-like cytoplasmic staining acting as internal control
Patchy faint granular background staining
61599.describe_en: CD79a immunostain shows the neoplastic cells to be largely negative, with at most faint, weak cytoplasmic staining in a subset. A rare admixed cell displays strong cytoplasmic positivity, confirming staining adequacy. Plasmablastic lymphoma frequently shows weak, partial or absent CD79a, reflecting loss of the mature B-cell program. The findings are compatible with EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma when interpreted with MUM1/CD138 positivity and EBER in situ hybridization.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows strong, diffuse CD79a together with CD20/PAX5, unlike the weak or absent CD79a of plasmablastic lymphoma.
Myeloma may be CD79a negative or weak as well, so it is separated by clinical/serologic features and usual EBER negativity.
CD79a negativity may suggest a non-B lineage, which is excluded by absence of CD3/CD2/CD56 and presence of MUM1/CD138 and immunoglobulin light-chain restriction.

61535.recognize_zh: 子宮頸內膜切片中，大型非典型淋巴細胞只塞滿在小血管與微血管管腔內（B 圖），周圍間質無腫瘤浸潤；BCL-2 以血管內團塊方式強陽性（C 圖）、MYC 核陽性（D 圖），符合 double-expressor 血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: endocervical stroma with glands; the stroma appears hypercellular at low power without a destructive mass
Panel B: dilated small vessels and capillaries filled with large atypical lymphoid cells admixed with red cells, sparing the surrounding stroma
Tumor cells are large with round to irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Panel C: BCL-2 highlights tumor cells confined to vascular lumina in a branching intravascular pattern
Panel D: MYC nuclear staining in a subset of the intravascular tumor cells
Composite journal figure at limited resolution; fine nuclear detail and MYC percentage cannot be assessed precisely
61535.describe_en: Composite figure of endocervical tissue. At low power (A) the endocervical stroma surrounding benign glands appears hypercellular, and at higher power (B) small vessels and capillaries are distended by large atypical lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei, with no significant extravascular infiltration. Immunohistochemistry shows strong BCL-2 expression in the intravascular tumor cells (C) and nuclear MYC expression in a subset of cells (D). In the context of B-cell lineage markers, findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma with MYC/BCL2 dual protein expression involving the female genital tract; the resolution of the composite limits quantitative scoring.

ddx.vs: It shows the same intravascular pattern but the cells are CD3ε+, CD56+, EBER+ and CD20−.

ddx.dx: Lymphovascular invasion by poorly differentiated carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma emboli are cohesive, keratin-positive and CD45/CD20-negative, whereas these are discohesive lymphoid cells.

ddx.dx: Leukemic cells or marginated leukocytes within vessels
ddx.vs: Circulating leukemia is present in all vessels with a matching peripheral blood picture, whereas IVLBCL cells are large atypical CD20+ B cells selectively packing small vessels.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double expression by IHC does not equal double-hit; FISH for MYC and BCL2 rearrangement is required to distinguish them.

61471.recognize_zh: 白血球密集的區域中，數顆中性球（含帶狀核）細胞質內有金褐色至黑褐色的瘧色素（hemozoin）顆粒，其中一顆還含深紫色寄生蟲殘骸；周圍紅血球中可見細小環狀體，符合惡性瘧原蟲感染伴含色素中性球。
features: Leukocyte-rich field (feathered edge/buffy-coat-like area) with many band and segmented neutrophils showing toxic granulation
Several neutrophils contain golden-brown to black hemozoin pigment granules in the cytoplasm
One neutrophil (center) contains pigment clumps together with purple granular material, consistent with phagocytosed parasite remnants
Numerous small delicate ring forms within normal-sized erythrocytes
Occasional monocytes and a darkly stained cell with condensed nucleus at the right
61471.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a leukocyte-rich area, shows many band and segmented neutrophils with toxic granulation, several of which contain golden-brown to black hemozoin pigment granules; one neutrophil also contains clumped purple material consistent with phagocytosed parasite remnants. Surrounding erythrocytes are of normal size and harbor small, delicate ring forms. No schizonts are identified. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria with pigment-laden neutrophils; a high proportion of pigment-containing neutrophils has been associated with severe disease.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine dark-purple azurophilic granules, whereas hemozoin is refractile golden-brown to black and accompanies intraerythrocytic rings.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and background in a different plane, while hemozoin is intracytoplasmic and brown rather than purple-black.
Pigment-laden leukocytes also occur in vivax, but vivax shows enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots and ameboid trophozoites.
Babesia lacks hemozoin, so pigment within neutrophils points to Plasmodium.

61407.recognize_zh: BCL2 染色低倍（40x）見多個結節呈不均勻、中度陽性，部分區域較淡；高倍（400x）為中大型腫瘤細胞膜狀/胞質陽性且強度不一，顯示 IRF4 重組大B細胞淋巴瘤中 BCL2 可呈變異性表現，不能據此判定為濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Low power (40x): nodular architecture with heterogeneous, moderate BCL2 staining across nodules; some nodules paler than surrounding areas
Negative pale round spaces (vessels/sinuses) and septa within the section
High power (400x): cytoplasmic and membranous BCL2 in many medium to large cells with variable intensity
Scattered small cells with stronger staining (likely admixed T cells) interspersed among weaker tumor cells
61407.describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemistry at low power shows a nodular pattern with heterogeneous, moderate staining that varies between nodules. At high power, many medium to large neoplastic cells show cytoplasmic/membranous BCL2 of variable intensity, admixed with scattered strongly positive small cells, likely reactive T cells. BCL2 expression is variable in large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement and does not by itself indicate t(14;18); correlation with MUM1 and IRF4/BCL2 FISH is required.

ddx.vs: FL typically shows strong uniform BCL2 in neoplastic follicles with BCL2 rearrangement by FISH and lacks strong MUM1/IRF4 rearrangement.
Reactive germinal center B cells are BCL2-negative, with positivity confined to mantle and T cells.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma shows strong BCL2 with MYC and BCL2 breaks on FISH rather than IRF4 rearrangement.

61343.recognize_zh: 上方中央一個細胞破裂後散出成束、交錯排列的柴束狀 Auer 小體（faggot cell），周圍異常前骨髓細胞核呈雙葉或摺疊狀、細胞質充滿粗大嗜天青顆粒，是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的典型線索。
features: Faggot cell: disrupted cell with numerous bundled, crisscrossing Auer rods spilled into the surrounding cytoplasm
Abnormal promyelocytes with folded, reniform to bilobed (butterfly-like) nuclei
Abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nuclear outline in places
Relatively fine chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Adjacent large immature cell with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin; scattered erythrocytes in background
61343.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of abnormal promyelocytes with folded to bilobed nuclei and abundant cytoplasm heavily laden with coarse azurophilic granules. One disrupted cell contains innumerable Auer rods arranged in bundles (a faggot cell). Normal maturing granulocytic elements are not appreciated in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA; confirmation by FISH or RT-PCR is required, as cryptic rearrangements may be missed by routine karyotype.

ddx.vs: Blasts usually carry single slender Auer rods and have round nuclei with perinuclear hofs, without bundles of rods in heavily granulated bilobed promyelocytes.
Reactive promyelocytes have round eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof, lack Auer rods, and show orderly maturation to neutrophils.

ddx.dx: APL with variant RARA fusion (e.g., ZBTB16::RARA)
ddx.vs: Variant forms may show more regular nuclei and fewer faggot cells, and require molecular testing to distinguish because of ATRA resistance in some variants.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have delicate folded nuclei with fine gray cytoplasmic granules, are nonspecific esterase positive and lack Auer rod bundles.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia — hypergranular abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and a faggot cell (bundled Auer rods)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指成束 Auer 小體的細胞，問「這叫什麼細胞？代表什麼疾病與遺傳異常？」答：faggot cell；APL，t(15;17) PML::RARA。
急症：APL 常合併 DIC 與高纖溶，懷疑時不必等基因結果，應立即開始 ATRA，並積極補充 cryoprecipitate/fibrinogen 與血小板。
治療：低/中危以 ATRA + arsenic trioxide 為標準；需注意 differentiation syndrome（發燒、呼吸窘迫、肺浸潤、體重增加），以 dexamethasone 處理。
確診：FISH 或 RT-PCR 找 PML::RARA；細胞化學 MPO 強陽性；flow 典型 CD34−/HLA-DR−、CD33+、CD117+。WHO 5th 此型不需 ≥20% 原始細胞門檻。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML with maturation（t(8;21)）的單一 Auer rod；APL 為雙葉/摺疊核、顆粒極多並有成束 faggot cell。微顆粒型 APL 則易誤為單核球性白血病，需靠 MPO 強陽性與 PML::RARA 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中上方散出成束 Auer 小體的細胞叫什麼？懷疑此病時最應立即給予的藥物是？
quiz.a: Faggot cell（APL）；立即給予 ATRA（all-trans retinoic acid）

61279.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片（A，圈起處）與高倍（B）可見骨小樑邊緣呈不規則扇貝狀侵蝕，旁邊為疏鬆水腫、纖維化的間質與散在異型淋巴球浸潤；免疫染色（C、D）凸顯核形不規則的大型異型淋巴球。這種腫瘤細胞貼著骨小樑、骨質被吸收的樣子，對應成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（ATLL）引起的破骨活化與高血鈣。
features: Panel A (low power H&E): variably cellular marrow with a circled paratrabecular area of altered, loose stroma
Panel B (H&E): bony trabecula with irregular, scalloped resorptive edge adjacent to edematous/fibrotic stroma containing scattered atypical lymphoid cells
Panel C (IHC): strong membranous-cytoplasmic staining of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei in an interstitial pattern
Panel D (IHC): weaker granular cytoplasmic staining of a similar interstitial population; markers are not labeled in the figure
Image resolution is limited; osteoclasts are not individually well resolved
61279.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a focal paratrabecular area in which the bony trabecula has an irregular, scalloped edge adjacent to loose, edematous and fibrotic stroma containing scattered atypical lymphoid cells. Immunohistochemical stains highlight an interstitial infiltrate of medium to large lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei; the specific antibodies are not labeled and resolution limits identification of osteoclasts. The picture suggests tumor-associated bone resorption. In a patient with HTLV-1 infection and a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell population, findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma with osteolytic bone remodeling.

ddx.vs: Forms cohesive epithelial clusters with desmoplasia that are keratin-positive and CD45/CD3-negative.
Infiltrate consists of CD138+ plasma cells with light-chain restriction rather than CD3+/CD4+ T cells.
Shows osteoclastic tunneling resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis without an atypical lymphoid infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS or Sezary syndrome
ddx.vs: Morphology and CD4+ phenotype overlap; ATLL is defined by clonally integrated HTLV-1 and typically strong CD25 expression.

61151.recognize_zh: 這是 CD25 免疫組化：一片中大型、核呈卵圓至腎形的腫瘤細胞，大多只有淡藍色背景染色，僅少數細胞胞質內可見細顆粒狀棕色染色，屬弱且局部陽性，需搭配 CD117/tryptase 判讀為異常肥大細胞表現 CD25。
features: Sheet of medium to large cells with oval, indented to reniform nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
Fine, dot-like granular brown cytoplasmic staining in scattered cells only
Most tumor cells show no convincing membranous or cytoplasmic CD25 signal
No strong, crisp membranous staining pattern identifiable at this magnification
Occasional small vacuoles/fat spaces in a densely cellular background
61151.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD25 on a densely cellular infiltrate composed of medium to large cells with oval to reniform nuclei and moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm. Only scattered cells show weak, fine granular cytoplasmic staining; the majority of the infiltrate lacks definite reactivity, and the dot-like pattern should be distinguished from pigment or nonspecific deposits. Interpretation requires correlation with CD117 and tryptase stains on the same infiltrate; aberrant CD25 expression by mast cells, if confirmed, supports systemic mastocytosis, here in the context of mast cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Pigment is refractile and golden-brown, is present on an unstained control slide, and is not confined to the cytoplasm of cells that coexpress CD117/tryptase.

ddx.dx: CD25+ activated T cells or regulatory T cells
ddx.vs: T cells are small lymphocytes with membranous CD25 that are CD3-positive and tryptase-negative, unlike the larger oval-nucleated mast cells.
Reactive mast cells are scattered, round, and CD25-negative, whereas neoplastic mast cells form clusters or sheets and express CD25 and/or CD2.

61023.recognize_zh: 視野內大量紅血球一端拉長變尖，呈淚滴或梨形（dacrocyte），部分尾端細長；多數細胞仍保有中央淡染，這種大量淚滴細胞是原發性骨髓纖維化等骨髓浸潤性疾病的典型血片表現。
features: Numerous teardrop/pear-shaped red cells with a single tapered tail
Some dacrocytes show long, thin, sharply pointed tails
Marked poikilocytosis with admixed oval and elongated red cells
Most red cells are normochromic with preserved central pallor
No leukocytes or nucleated red cells in this field; platelets not clearly seen
61023.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis dominated by numerous dacrocytes (teardrop cells), several with elongated tapering tails, admixed with ovalocytes. Red cells are largely normochromic with preserved central pallor. No leukocytes or nucleated red cells are present in this field to assess for leukoerythroblastosis. In a patient with splenomegaly and marrow fibrosis, these findings are consistent with a myelophthisic picture such as primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia shows occasional dacrocytes but is dominated by microcytic, hypochromic target cells with a high RBC count.
Morphologically identical dacrocytes; separation requires marrow biopsy showing tumor cells rather than MPN-type megakaryocytes and fibrosis.
Artifactual teardrops have tails all pointing in the same direction, whereas true dacrocytes point in random directions as here.
Can show teardrops but has oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with an elevated MCV.

exam.answer_en: Dacrocytosis — numerous teardrop cells suggesting marrow fibrosis or infiltration, such as primary myelofibrosis
pearls_zh: 考法：辨識淚滴形紅血球並問最常見病因 → 骨髓纖維化（PMF）或骨髓浸潤；紅血球擠出纖維化骨髓或通過脾臟時變形。
配套血片：leukoerythroblastosis（有核紅血球 + 左移顆粒球）加強骨髓浸潤的判斷。
PMF 驅動突變：JAK2 V617F、CALR、MPL；三者皆陰性稱 triple-negative，預後較差。
骨髓抽吸常 dry tap，需切片並以網狀纖維染色評估 fibrosis grade（MF-0 至 MF-3）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為推片製作假象；假象的尾端都朝同一方向，真正的 dacrocyte 尾端方向隨機。

quiz.q: 脾腫大病人血片見圖中大量淚滴狀紅血球，最常提示何種骨髓病變？
quiz.a: 骨髓纖維化或浸潤（如 primary myelofibrosis）

60895.recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下紅血球前驅細胞核內的濃密異染色質（heterochromatin）中散布許多圓形、電子透亮的小洞，呈海綿狀「瑞士起司」外觀，這是 CDA type I 的超微結構特徵。
features: Transmission electron micrograph at high magnification of erythroid precursor nuclear chromatin
Electron-dense heterochromatin masses riddled with numerous round electron-lucent holes of varying size (spongy, 'Swiss cheese' pattern)
Larger lucent inclusion with membrane-like rim within one heterochromatin mass, possibly cytoplasmic invagination
Intervening finely granular euchromatin/nucleoplasm of moderate electron density
Portion of extracellular/cytoplasmic lucent space at lower right
60895.describe_en: Transmission electron micrograph at high magnification of an erythroid precursor nucleus shows irregular, electron-dense heterochromatin masses containing numerous small round electron-lucent vacuole-like spaces, imparting a spongy 'Swiss cheese' appearance. One heterochromatin mass contains a larger lucent inclusion with a membranous rim, suggestive of a cytoplasmic invagination. The nuclear envelope and intercellular chromatin bridges cannot be assessed at this field. Findings are consistent with the characteristic ultrastructure of congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type I.

ddx.vs: CDA II shows peripheral double membranes (ER cisternae parallel to the plasma membrane) and binucleate erythroblasts on light microscopy rather than spongy 'Swiss cheese' heterochromatin.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts show open, finely dispersed chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony but lack the lucent holes within dense heterochromatin.

MDS erythroid dysplasia may show nuclear irregularities and ring sideroblasts, but spongy heterochromatin and internuclear chromatin bridges are characteristic of CDA I (CDAN1/CDIN1) rather than acquired dysplasia.

exam.answer_en: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type I — EM of erythroblast nucleus showing spongy 'Swiss cheese' heterochromatin
pearls_zh: 考法：非光學圖片（TEM），考官指電子緻密異染色質中布滿透亮小洞，問「這個超微結構特徵是哪一型 CDA？」→ CDA type I。
光學對照：CDA I 為巨母紅樣（megaloblastoid）紅母細胞，特徵是兩個細胞核間的 internuclear chromatin bridge，偶見雙核。
遺傳：CDAN1 或 CDIN1（C15orf41）突變，體染色體隱性；部分病人有骨骼異常（如指/趾畸形）。
治療：interferon-alpha 對部分 CDA I 病人可改善貧血，是與其他 CDA 不同的考點；另需處理鐵過載。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 CDA type II 的電顯混淆：CDA II 的超微結構是平行細胞膜的周邊雙層膜（peripheral double membrane），不是核內海綿狀 Swiss cheese 異染色質。

quiz.q: 這張電顯中紅母細胞核異染色質呈「瑞士起司」樣，代表哪一型 CDA？光學顯微鏡下的對應特徵是什麼？
quiz.a: CDA type I；megaloblastoid 紅母細胞與 internuclear chromatin bridge

60831.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片與抹片中出現巨大、多核或核分葉的怪異細胞（箭頭），乍看像巨核細胞；但 CD138 呈膜狀陽性、CD61 陰性，而真正的巨核細胞（箭頭處）CD61 陽性、CD138 陰性，證實為巨大怪異的骨髓瘤細胞。
features: Hypercellular marrow with numerous plasma cells, including giant bizarre cells with multilobated or multiple nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (panel A, arrows)
Giant cells mimic megakaryocytes by size and nuclear lobation but have more rounded, separate nuclei with coarse chromatin and some with perinuclear hof
Aspirate (panel B) shows large cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric irregular nuclei among smaller hematopoietic cells
CD138 (panel C) shows strong membranous staining of the giant bizarre cells; arrowheads mark negative megakaryocytes
CD61 (panel D) stains megakaryocytes (arrowheads) while the multinucleated myeloma cells are negative
60831.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow infiltrated by atypical plasma cells, including numerous giant, bizarre multinucleated and multilobated forms with abundant cytoplasm that closely mimic megakaryocytes. Aspirate smears show large basophilic cells with irregular eccentric nuclei. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong membranous CD138 expression in the giant cells, which are CD61-negative, whereas true megakaryocytes are CD61-positive and CD138-negative. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with giant bizarre (anaplastic/pleomorphic) myeloma cells mimicking megakaryocytes.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single contiguous lobulated nucleus with granular cytoplasm and are CD61/CD42b-positive and CD138-negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or sarcoma with tumor giant cells
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells form cohesive clusters, are cytokeratin- or lineage-marker-positive and lack CD138/light-chain restriction of plasma cells (note carcinomas may express CD138, so keratin and light chains are needed).
Osteoclasts have multiple uniform, separate small nuclei with nucleoli, lie near bone surfaces and are CD68-positive/CD138-negative.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or Hodgkin-like giant cells
ddx.vs: These are CD30-positive with T-cell or Hodgkin phenotype and lack CD138/cytoplasmic light chain restriction.

captions: A: marrow biopsy with giant bizarre multinucleated myeloma cells (arrows) mimicking megakaryocytes; B: aspirate with large atypical cells; C: CD138 IHC positive in giant cells, megakaryocytes negative (arrowheads); D: CD61 IHC positive in megakaryocytes (arrowheads), myeloma cells negative

60767.recognize_zh: 左側骨髓切片由片狀、核卵圓至腎形的芽細胞取代；右側 NPM1 免疫染色在芽細胞呈核加細胞質的紅色瀰漫染色，而箭頭所指的正常細胞只有核染色，這種「細胞質異位」模式代表 NPM1 突變。
features: H&E: hypercellular core biopsy replaced by sheets of monotonous blasts with oval to folded/reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm
Occasional small nucleoli; paucity of normal trilineage hematopoiesis
NPM1 IHC (red chromogen): strong staining of both nucleus and cytoplasm in the majority of blasts
Internal control cells (arrows) show nuclear-restricted NPM1 staining with clear cytoplasm
Scattered fat spaces and small residual non-neoplastic cells between blasts
60767.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (left, H&E) is hypercellular and diffusely replaced by sheets of blasts with oval to folded nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm, consistent with blasts showing monocytic features. Immunohistochemistry for nucleophosmin (right) shows aberrant cytoplasmic as well as nuclear staining in the neoplastic cells, while residual normal cells (arrows) retain nuclear-restricted staining. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with NPM1 mutation; confirmation by molecular testing and assessment for co-occurring FLT3-ITD are recommended.

ddx.dx: AML with wild-type NPM1 (e.g. monocytic AML NOS)
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, but NPM1 IHC is restricted to the nucleus in all blasts, without cytoplasmic delocalization.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma or AML with other genetic drivers such as KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: Shows comparable monocytic blasts but nuclear-only NPM1 staining and a distinct cytogenetic/molecular lesion.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: Large cells express CD20/PAX5 rather than myeloid/monocytic markers and have nuclear-only NPM1 staining.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma with NPM1::ALK
ddx.vs: Also shows cytoplasmic NPM staining from the fusion protein, but cells are pleomorphic hallmark cells that are CD30+ and ALK+ rather than myeloid blasts.

exam.answer_en: AML with NPM1 mutation — NPM1 IHC shows aberrant cytoplasmic plus nuclear staining in blasts, nuclear-only in residual normal cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指 NPM1 染色中細胞質也著色的母細胞，並對照箭頭處只有核染色的正常細胞，問「這個染色模式代表什麼？」→ NPM1 突變造成蛋白異位到細胞質（NPMc+）。
機轉：NPM1 exon 12 突變使 C 端核仁定位訊號喪失並產生新的 nuclear export signal，蛋白滯留細胞質；IHC 可作為分子檢測的替代篩檢。
表型與分類：常 CD34−、HLA-DR 可陰性，常有單核球分化；WHO 5th 不需母細胞 20% 門檻，ICC 2022 要求 ≥10%。
預後：ELN 2022 中 NPM1 突變且無 FLT3-ITD 為 favorable，合併 FLT3-ITD 為 intermediate；NPM1 可用 RT-qPCR 追蹤 MRD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 ALK+ anaplastic large cell lymphoma：NPM1::ALK 融合也造成 NPM 細胞質染色，但 ALCL 為 CD30+、ALK+ 的多形性 hallmark cells，而非骨髓性母細胞。

quiz.q: NPM1 免疫染色中母細胞呈細胞質加細胞核著色，而箭頭處細胞只有核著色，代表什麼？箭頭處細胞的角色為何？
quiz.a: NPM1 突變（蛋白細胞質異位，AML with NPM1 mutation）；箭頭處為正常細胞，作為內部對照

60639.recognize_zh: 單一小至中型成熟淋巴球，核圓、染色質粗塊，細胞質稀少淡藍，其中可見數條細長針狀、類似 Auer 小體的結晶樣包涵體，但細胞本身並非芽細胞。
features: Single small-to-medium lymphoid cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells with high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with coarse, clumped mature chromatin; no distinct nucleolus
Thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm containing several slender, needle-like, rod-shaped pinkish-purple inclusions resembling Auer rods
Small fragment of similar fibrillar material just outside the cell membrane
Background red cells with an adjacent echinocyte; no other leukocytes in view
60639.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mature-appearing lymphocyte with a round nucleus, condensed clumped chromatin and scant pale blue cytoplasm. The cytoplasm contains several thin, elongated, needle-like azurophilic inclusions resembling Auer rods, with a small fragment of similar material adjacent to the cell. The mature chromatin and absence of nucleoli argue against a myeloblast. Findings are suggestive of a lymphoproliferative disorder with Auer rod-like crystalline (likely immunoglobulin) inclusions; flow cytometry and MPO cytochemistry (expected negative) are recommended.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods occur in blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO positive, whereas this cell has mature clumped chromatin.
LGLs have more abundant cytoplasm with discrete round azurophilic granules rather than elongated needle-shaped inclusions.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with crystalline inclusions
ddx.vs: Crystal-containing plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and more abundant cytoplasm, and express CD138 rather than a mature B- or T-cell phenotype.
Artifacts lie in a different focal plane or outside the cell and lack the uniform rod shape, whereas these inclusions are within the cytoplasm.

60703.recognize_zh: 周邊血出現大型、細胞質深嗜鹼性、核偏位且有核旁淡染區的漿母細胞樣（plasmablastic）細胞，核染色質較開放、可見核仁，在 KSHV 相關多中心 Castleman 病背景下，指向其衍生的大 B 細胞淋巴瘤進入白血病期。
features: Large atypical cells, roughly 2–3 times a small lymphocyte, with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round-to-oval nuclei with a paranuclear pale zone (hof) in some cells
Nuclear chromatin moderately open/stippled with small nucleoli, more immature than a mature plasma cell
Cell with a pale cytoplasmic projection at the edge (arrow)
Accompanying mature neutrophils; background red cells without rouleaux
60703.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating large atypical lymphoid cells with abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm, eccentrically placed nuclei, perinuclear clearing in some cells, and relatively open chromatin with small nucleoli, imparting a plasmablastic/immunoblastic appearance. Mature neutrophils are also present, and there is no conspicuous rouleaux formation. Findings are suggestive of a leukemic phase of a KSHV/HHV8-positive large B-cell lymphoma arising in multicentric Castleman disease; confirmation requires LANA-1 immunostaining and assessment of lambda light chain restriction.

ddx.vs: PCL cells are usually more mature with clumped clockface chromatin, CD138+/CD20−, HHV8-negative and associated with a serum M-protein and lytic bone disease.
Reactive cells form a polymorphous spectrum with polytypic light chains and HHV8/LANA negativity, whereas this lymphoma is monotypic (typically lambda) and LANA-1 positive.
PEL is also HHV8+ with plasmablastic cells but presents in body cavity effusions, usually EBV co-infected and lacks surface Ig, rather than arising from MCD.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is EBV+ (EBER) and HHV8-negative, typically in extranodal oral/GI sites.

captions: Peripheral blood: large plasmablastic cells with deep basophilic cytoplasm among neutrophils (arrow marks a cytoplasmic projection)
High power: plasmablastic cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and open chromatin

60511.recognize_zh: 與紅血球大小相近的小圓細胞，圓核染色質緻密成塊且無核仁，外圍有一圈窄而均勻的淡藍色細胞質、無顆粒，是正常靜止淋巴球。
features: Small round cell comparable in size to adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with a narrow, even rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Round, slightly eccentric nucleus with dense clumped chromatin
No visible nucleolus
No cytoplasmic granules; background normocytic red cells with central pallor
60511.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small round lymphocyte comparable in size to adjacent red cells. The nucleus is round with dense clumped chromatin and no nucleolus, surrounded by a narrow, even rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with a normal resting lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: Nucleated red cells have a smaller, darker pyknotic nucleus and pinkish hemoglobinized or polychromatic cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes are larger with abundant cytoplasm showing basophilic edges and indentation by red cells.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell or follicular lymphoma cell in blood
ddx.vs: Neoplastic small lymphocytes often show nuclear notches or clefts in a monotonous population and require flow cytometry for confirmation.

exam.answer_en: Normal resting lymphocyte — red-cell-sized round cell with dense clumped chromatin and narrow even rim of agranular cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：基本形態題，考官可能要求與旁邊紅血球比大小，並說明「小淋巴球是抹片的大小尺規」。
正常小淋巴球直徑約 7–10 μm，大小約等於紅血球，是判斷抹片其他細胞大小的內建尺規。
周邊血淋巴球約 80% 為 T 細胞（CD4 多於 CD8）、B 細胞約 10–15%、NK 細胞約 10%；抹片形態無法區分亞群，需靠 flow。
淋巴瘤細胞進入血液時要注意核的輪廓：MCL 核不規則、FL 核有深切跡（buttock cell），正常淋巴球核圓滑。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與有核紅血球混淆：nRBC 染色質更均勻深黑、細胞質帶粉紅/多色性；淋巴球染色質塊狀且細胞質為淡藍色。

quiz.q: 與周圍紅血球相比，這顆細胞的大小與 N:C 比如何？它是什麼細胞？
quiz.a: 大小約等於紅血球、N:C 比極高；正常小淋巴球

60447.recognize_zh: Factor VIII-related antigen（vWF）免疫染色把巨核細胞染成深棕色，可見其大小落差很大：除少數大型細胞（右下、中央）外，散布大量只比周圍造血細胞略大的單核小型巨核細胞（micromegakaryocytes），這種小而單核的型態即巨核細胞發育不良的線索。
features: IHC for factor VIII-related antigen (von Willebrand factor) with strong brown cytoplasmic staining of megakaryocytes
Megakaryocytes markedly variable in size; numerous small mononuclear or hypolobated forms comparable to surrounding precursors
Few large megakaryocytes (lower right, center) with hypolobated nuclei
Megakaryocytes scattered singly and in loose small groups rather than tight clusters
Faint background staining of plasma/endothelium; negative hematopoietic background with interspersed adipocytes
60447.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for factor VIII-related antigen (von Willebrand factor) on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights megakaryocytes with strong cytoplasmic staining. The megakaryocytes show a wide range in size, including numerous small mononuclear forms (micromegakaryocytes) and a few larger hypolobated cells, distributed singly and in small loose groups. Nonspecific faint staining of background plasma and stroma is present. Increased small mononuclear megakaryocytes are a feature of megakaryocytic dysplasia; in the setting of GATA2 deficiency with monosomy 7, findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Normal marrow megakaryocytes are predominantly large with multilobated nuclei, with only rare small immature forms, unlike the many micromegakaryocytes highlighted here.
CML dwarf megakaryocytes occur in a markedly hypercellular granulocytic marrow with BCR::ABL1, not in a hypocellular pediatric marrow with monosomy 7.
AMKL shows sheets or clusters of megakaryoblasts with blast-level immaturity and >=20% blasts, whereas here the small megakaryocytes are scattered with no blast increase.

60383.recognize_zh: 霍奇金區域的 CD20 染色中，大型 Hodgkin 細胞的細胞膜染色強弱不一、多為薄弱或不完整的膜染，部分大細胞幾乎陰性；背景散布的小淋巴球僅少數陽性，其餘多為陰性（T 細胞為主）。大細胞 B 細胞標記弱化／不一致是典型霍奇金細胞（HRS）的特徵之一。
features: CD20 IHC in the Hodgkin-type area
Large cells with weak, incomplete or variable membranous CD20; some large cells negative
Small scattered strongly stained cells and cell fragments/debris
Background small lymphocytes largely CD20-negative, consistent with a T-cell-rich microenvironment
No sheets of strongly CD20-positive large B cells
60383.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry in the Hodgkin-type area shows weak to moderate, often incomplete membranous staining in a subset of the scattered large neoplastic cells, while other large cells are negative. The background small lymphocytes are predominantly CD20-negative, with scattered positive small cells and dot-like debris. There are no sheets of strongly CD20-positive large cells. Weak and heterogeneous CD20 in the large cells, together with CD30 positivity, supports Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in Richter transformation of Hodgkin lymphoma type.

ddx.vs: DLBCL-type Richter shows confluent sheets of large cells with uniformly strong CD20 and PAX5, unlike this weak, variable staining of scattered cells.
THRLBCL large cells are strongly and uniformly CD20-positive, CD30- and CD15-negative, in contrast to weak/variable CD20 in HRS cells.
LP cells show strong CD20 and OCT2 expression within small B-cell-rich nodules, unlike the weak CD20 and T-cell-rich background here.

60191.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中有多顆大型芽細胞（核圓、染色質細緻、可見核仁、胞質藍色無顆粒），同時可見顆粒稀少、胞質淡粉的骨髓細胞／後骨髓細胞，以及下方核分葉不足的帶狀或雙葉嗜中性球（類Pelger），芽細胞增加合併顆粒球發育不良，符合MDS伴過多芽細胞。
features: Increased blasts: large cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, one or more nucleoli and scant to moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Hypogranular myelocytes and metamyelocytes with pale pink-gray cytoplasm and sparse granules
Hypolobated neutrophils/bands with bilobed or band-like nuclei (pseudo-Pelger forms)
Occasional normally granulated promyelocyte with coarse azurophilic granules for comparison
Scattered erythroid precursors; no Auer rods seen
60191.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with increased blasts, which are large with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, prominent nucleoli and scant to moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm, without Auer rods. Maturing granulocytes are dysplastic, including hypogranular myelocytes and metamyelocytes and hypolobated bilobed neutrophils, while an occasional promyelocyte retains normal coarse granulation. Scattered erythroid precursors are present. With 12% blasts on a 500-cell differential and dysgranulopoiesis, the findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts (former RAEB-2).

ddx.vs: AML with maturation requires ≥20% blasts and often shows Auer rods, whereas blasts here number 10–19%.
Hypogranular APL cells have bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei and often faggot cells, with coagulopathy and PML::RARA, rather than round-nucleated blasts with separate maturing dysplastic neutrophils.
CMML-2 has similar blast counts but requires peripheral monocytosis and shows promonocytes with folded nuclei.
Inherited Pelger-Huët neutrophils are uniformly bilobed with normal granulation and no increase in blasts.

exam.answer_en: MDS with excess blasts-2 (RAEB-2) — increased large agranular blasts (12%) with hypogranular myelocytes and pseudo-Pelger neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著大型、有核仁、無顆粒的芽細胞要你計數，再指著雙葉、低顆粒的中性球問 pseudo-Pelger-Huët；兩者合併即 MDS-EB。
Blast 計數必須用骨髓抹片 500 顆有核細胞分類（周邊 200 顆）；抽吸不良或纖維化時可用 CD34 IHC 輔助估算。
WHO 2016 EB-2：骨髓 10–19%、周邊 5–19% 或有 Auer rods；WHO 5th 為 MDS-IB2；ICC 2022 骨髓 10–19% 則稱 MDS/AML。
必做 NGS 與核型：TP53（multi-hit 為極差預後）、complex karyotype；以 IPSS-M 分層，高風險者 HMA 加評估 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: Pseudo-Pelger 易與遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly 混淆；遺傳性（LBR 基因）幾乎所有中性球皆雙葉、顆粒正常且無血球低下，MDS 則只佔部分並合併低顆粒與其他發育不良。

quiz.q: 圖中雙葉、染色質粗塊、顆粒稀少的中性球叫什麼？它與遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly 如何區分？
quiz.a: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët neutrophil；遺傳性為幾乎全部中性球雙葉、顆粒正常、無血球低下或其他發育不良（LBR 突變）。

60127.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央是一個細胞質充滿橘紅顆粒的嗜酸性球，但細胞核只有一個偏心、緻密的圓形核而沒有正常的雙葉，屬於 Pelger-Huët 異常在嗜酸性球的低分葉表現。
features: Eosinophil with abundant orange-pink granular cytoplasm
Hypolobated, single round eccentric nucleus with dense clumped chromatin instead of the usual bilobed form
Adjacent degenerated/disrupted granulocyte with fragmented nucleus
Background red cells largely normocytic with scattered platelets
Single-cell field; overall proportion of affected granulocytes cannot be judged
60127.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an eosinophil with abundant orange-pink specific granules and a hypolobated, non-segmented round nucleus with coarsely clumped, mature chromatin. A nearby granulocyte is degenerated. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. In the context of neutrophils showing bilobed pince-nez nuclei, the hypolobated mature-chromatin eosinophil is consistent with Pelger-Huët anomaly.

ddx.vs: Myelocytes have a larger, less condensed round nucleus with visible chromatin pattern and often admixed basophilic immature granules, whereas this nucleus shows dense mature chromatin.
Acquired forms affect only a subset of cells and are often hypogranular with cytopenias or other dysplasia, while the inherited anomaly involves nearly all granulocytes in a healthy person.
Basophils have large dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus rather than refractile orange-pink granules.

60063.recognize_zh: CellaVision 截圖中的每顆細胞都是比紅血球大 1.5–2 倍的母細胞：核質比極高、染色質細緻均勻、細胞質只剩一小片淡藍色且無顆粒，許多細胞可見小圓空泡與手鏡狀（hand-mirror）細胞質突起；形態一致符合淋巴母細胞，此例為兒童 B-ALL。
features: Monotonous population of blasts about 1.5-2 times red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, often as a polar tail or bleb (hand-mirror forms)
Round to irregular or angular nuclei with fine, homogeneous chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Small discrete clear vacuoles in many cells
No Auer rods or granules; background red cells unremarkable with rare platelets
60063.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, digitally captured cell gallery (CellaVision), shows a monotonous population of circulating blasts. The blasts are small to intermediate, measuring about 1.5 to 2 times the diameter of a red cell, with very high N:C ratio, round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed homogeneous chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is scant, pale blue, and agranular, frequently drawn out into a polar tail or bleb, and several cells contain small discrete clear vacuoles; Auer rods are absent. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts and, together with the flow cytometric phenotype, support B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are generally larger with more cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli, and may contain granules or Auer rods; flow cytometry is required when blasts are agranular.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous prominent vacuoles and more clumped chromatin with multiple nucleoli, and are TdT-negative mature B cells.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and more condensed chromatin, with a heterogeneous rather than monotonous population.
Hematogones are rare in peripheral blood, have more homogeneous smudged dark chromatin, and show an orderly maturation pattern on flow cytometry.

29663.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一個核圓、顆粒減少的發育不良顆粒球細胞質內有一條細長的 Auer 小體（黑箭頭），另可見核低分葉的 pseudo-Pelger 樣嗜中性球（紅箭頭）及帶細胞質尾巴、含 Auer 小體的芽細胞（藍箭頭），符合 AML 伴骨髓發育不良相關變化。
features: Panel A: maturing granulocyte with a round nucleus, clumped chromatin, hypogranular pale cytoplasm and a slender Auer rod (black arrow)
Panels A-C: blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and cytoplasmic tails/projections (blue arrows), one with a thin Auer rod
Panels B-C: hypolobated/non-lobated, hypogranular neutrophils with condensed chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-Huet forms, red arrows)
Red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and rare elongated forms
29663.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) shows circulating blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and cytoplasmic tail-like projections, some containing thin Auer rods. Notably, an Auer rod is present in a hypogranular maturing granulocyte with a round, mature-appearing nucleus (A, black arrow). Additional hypolobated, hypogranular pseudo-Pelger-Huet neutrophils are present (red arrows). Findings are consistent with a myeloid neoplasm with dysgranulopoiesis and Auer rods, supporting acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes; Auer rods in dysplastic mature granulocytes confirm that the maturing cells belong to the neoplastic clone.

ddx.vs: Auer rods can occur in MDS, so the distinction rests on blast percentage (<20% in MDS) rather than morphology of the rods.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei with heavy azurophilic granulation and bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells), with PML::RARA fusion.
It shows large blasts with a single long tapered Auer rod, salmon-colored perinuclear granules and pseudo-Pelger forms without true multilineage dysplasia, confirmed by cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Toxic granulation / Dohle bodies in infection
ddx.vs: Dohle bodies are pale blue cytoplasmic patches and toxic granules are coarse dots, neither forming a crystalline pink-purple rod.

exam.answer_en: AML with myelodysplasia-related changes — Auer rod within a hypogranular maturing granulocyte, with blasts and pseudo-Pelger–Huët neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指黑箭頭（成熟顆粒球內的 Auer rod）、紅箭頭（pseudo-Pelger）與藍箭頭（母細胞），問各是什麼；重點是 Auer rod 出現在成熟細胞，證明該細胞屬腫瘤克隆。
Auer rod 成分：聚集的初級（azurophilic）顆粒，MPO 與 Sudan black B 陽性；看到即排除純淋巴系白血病。
Auer rods 出現在成熟嗜中性球的 AML 經典關聯為 t(8;21) RUNX1::RUNX1T1，因此需做 karyotype/RT-PCR；本圖有 pseudo-Pelger 與顆粒減少則支持 MR 背景。
MDS 分類：WHO 2016 中 MDS 見 Auer rods 即歸為 MDS-EB-2；最終診斷仍依母細胞比例（AML 需 ≥20%，有定義性遺傳異常者除外）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 Auer rod 誤認為 toxic granulation 或 Döhle body：toxic granules 為散在粗大深色顆粒，Döhle body 為胞質周邊淡藍斑；Auer rod 是紅紫色細長針狀結構，且出現在低顆粒化的發育不良細胞中。

quiz.q: 黑箭頭所指的細長紅紫色桿狀結構是什麼？由何種成分構成、哪兩種細胞化學染色陽性？
quiz.a: Auer rod；聚集的 azurophilic（primary）granules，MPO 與 Sudan black B 陽性。

12511.recognize_zh: 血液抹片（A）可見多顆邊緣尖角、形態破碎的紅血球碎片（schistocytes，含盔狀細胞），腎臟切片（B）箭頭處小動脈管腔被嗜伊紅性血栓或內膜增厚阻塞，呈血栓性微血管病變（TMA），符合 TTP/TMA 表現；但病史為接受 bortezomib 治療的骨髓瘤患者，藥物相關 TMA 須列入考量。
features: Red cell fragments with sharp angular edges, including helmet cells and triangular schistocytes (panel A)
Several crenated red cells (echinocytes) and reduced platelets in the field
Kidney arteriole with luminal occlusion by eosinophilic thrombotic material and concentric intimal change (arrow, panel B)
Glomerulus with congested, mildly bloodless-appearing capillary loops in the upper field
Tubules containing eosinophilic proteinaceous casts and focal epithelial injury
12511.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous schistocytes including helmet and triangular fragments, with several crenated red cells and few platelets in the field. Renal biopsy shows an arteriole whose lumen is occluded by eosinophilic thrombotic material with concentric intimal change, a glomerulus with congested capillary loops, and tubules containing eosinophilic proteinaceous casts. Findings are consistent with a thrombotic microangiopathy. Given the stated history of plasma cell myeloma treated with bortezomib after autologous transplant, ADAMTS13 activity is essential to distinguish acquired TTP (activity <10%) from drug-induced or transplant-associated TMA, and the tubular casts should be evaluated for light chain cast nephropathy.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced thrombotic microangiopathy (bortezomib or other agents)
ddx.vs: Drug-induced TMA has identical schistocytes and renal thrombi but ADAMTS13 activity above 10% and improvement after drug withdrawal.
TA-TMA also shows schistocytes with renal arteriolar injury but has preserved ADAMTS13, elevated sC5b-9, and is linked to conditioning, calcineurin inhibitors, or GVHD.
aHUS is dominated by renal TMA with complement-pathway abnormalities and ADAMTS13 activity above 10%.
DIC can produce schistocytes but shows prolonged PT/aPTT with low fibrinogen, whereas coagulation times are usually normal in TTP.

exam.answer_en: Thrombotic microangiopathy after autologous transplant — schistocytes on smear with arteriolar thrombotic occlusion on renal biopsy
pearls_zh: 考法：左圖考官指碎片紅血球、右圖指小動脈，問「這兩張合起來是什麼病理過程」；答案 thrombotic microangiopathy（MAHA + 微血管血栓）。
鑑別關鍵：ADAMTS13 活性 <10% 支持 TTP；否則需考慮藥物相關 TMA（如 bortezomib 等蛋白酶體抑制劑）、transplant-associated TMA、complement-mediated aHUS。
TTP 處置：懷疑時立即 plasma exchange + 類固醇，可加 caplacizumab 與 rituximab；非 TTP 的 TMA 以停用可疑藥物與支持治療為主，補體介導者考慮 C5 抑制劑。
溶血指標：LDH 升高、haptoglobin 降低、網狀紅血球增加、DAT 陰性；骨髓瘤病人腎小管蛋白管柱需評估 light chain cast nephropathy。
exam.pitfall_zh: 不要一看到 schistocytes 加血小板低就直接診斷 TTP；移植後、化療藥物與 DIC 都可造成 TMA，需以 ADAMTS13、凝血功能（DIC 有 PT/aPTT 延長、纖維蛋白原下降）區分。

quiz.q: 圖 A 的碎片紅血球加上圖 B 小動脈管腔阻塞，代表什麼病理過程？要區分 TTP 與其他成因最關鍵的檢查為何？
quiz.a: Thrombotic microangiopathy（TMA）；ADAMTS13 活性（<10% 支持 TTP）。

16991.recognize_zh: 視野中幾乎沒有正常大小的血小板，只見中央一顆大型、深染顆粒狀的血小板（接近小紅血球大小），紅血球形態大致正常、無破碎紅血球或異常白血球，符合免疫性血小板低下（ITP）的血小板減少合併大型血小板。
features: Marked paucity of platelets in the field
Single large, darkly staining granular platelet at center, approaching the size of a small RBC
Red cells normocytic with central pallor; occasional overlapping and one elongated cell but no schistocytes
No leukocyte abnormalities or circulating blasts in view
Warm color cast and limited resolution of the photograph
16991.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows markedly decreased platelets, with a single large, darkly granular platelet in the center of the field. Red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes, spherocytosis or significant poikilocytosis, and no abnormal leukocytes are present in this field. Isolated thrombocytopenia with large platelets and otherwise unremarkable morphology reflects increased peripheral destruction with compensatory young platelet release. Findings are consistent with immune thrombocytopenia in the appropriate clinical context, which remains a diagnosis of exclusion.

ddx.vs: Pseudothrombocytopenia shows platelet clumps or satellitism on the smear, especially at the feathered edge, which are absent here.
Inherited forms show uniformly giant platelets from birth with abnormal aggregation studies or Dohle-like neutrophil inclusions, requiring family history and platelet function or genetic testing.
TTP shows schistocytes and polychromasia with hemolysis, which are not seen in this field.
Marrow disorders show small platelets or additional cytopenias, macrocytosis, dysplasia, blasts or leukoerythroblastosis.

exam.answer_en: Immune thrombocytopenia — markedly reduced platelets with a large granular platelet and otherwise normal red and white cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「血小板哪裡異常？還要排除什麼？」答：數量極少且偏大（年輕血小板），紅血球無 schistocytes、無異常白血球，符合孤立性血小板低下。
ITP 為排除性診斷，定義血小板 <100×10⁹/L；成人應篩檢 HIV、HCV，並依臨床考慮 H. pylori；典型病例不一定需骨髓檢查。
病程分期：newly diagnosed（<3 個月）、persistent（3–12 個月）、chronic（>12 個月）；一線治療為類固醇，需快速提升時加 IVIG。
Immature platelet fraction（IPF）與 MPV 在周邊破壞型血小板低下常升高，可輔助與骨髓生成不足區分。
exam.pitfall_zh: 看到血小板少時最易漏掉 EDTA 假性血小板低下；應先檢查抹片 feathered edge 有無血小板團或衛星現象，再考慮 ITP。

quiz.q: 此抹片中央的大型顆粒狀小體是什麼？在診斷 ITP 前抹片上必須排除哪兩種發現？
quiz.a: 大型血小板；血小板凝集/衛星現象（假性血小板低下）與 schistocytes（TMA）

16927.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎完全被脂肪細胞取代，脂肪間只剩少量間質、微血管與零星細胞，看不到成群的造血細胞，左側為骨小樑，符合再生不良性貧血（aplastic anemia）的極度低細胞性骨髓；病因（如苯暴露）無法由形態判斷。
features: Markedly hypocellular marrow, nearly entirely replaced by adipocytes
Only scant residual stromal cells, capillaries and scattered dark cells between fat spaces
No identifiable clusters of erythroid, myeloid or megakaryocytic precursors
Bony trabecula along the left edge and at upper right
No fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal infiltrate; low resolution precludes assessment of residual cell types
16927.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a markedly hypocellular marrow in which the intertrabecular space is almost entirely replaced by adipose tissue, with only scant residual stromal cells and small vessels. Erythroid, myeloid and megakaryocytic elements are not identifiable in this field, and there is no fibrosis, granuloma or abnormal infiltrate. Image resolution limits evaluation of residual lymphocytes and plasma cells. Findings are consistent with severe aplastic anemia; the etiology, such as benzene exposure, cannot be determined morphologically and requires clinical history.

ddx.vs: Hypoplastic MDS retains foci with dysplastic megakaryocytes or erythroid precursors, increased CD34+ blasts or MDS-defining cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Normal age-related hypocellularity or tangential/subcortical biopsy
ddx.vs: Subcortical marrow in older adults can be fatty, so cellularity must be assessed in an adequate core of deeper intertrabecular spaces and correlated with age and blood counts.
Hypocellular AML shows residual cellular areas composed of blasts that are CD34 or MPO-positive.
Post-therapy aplasia looks similar but may show serous fat atrophy or edema and is identified by treatment history and recovery.

exam.answer_en: Aplastic anemia (benzene-associated) — markedly hypocellular marrow replaced by fat without infiltrate, fibrosis or dysplastic foci
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「cellularity 大約多少？這樣的切片要排除什麼？」答：極度低細胞（脂肪取代），需排除 hypocellular MDS、hypocellular AML 與取樣不足。
Camitta 嚴重度：骨髓 cellularity <25%（或 25–50% 但殘存造血細胞 <30%）加上以下兩項：ANC <0.5×10⁹/L、血小板 <20×10⁹/L、網狀紅血球過低；ANC <0.2 為 very severe。
評估時應做 PNH clone flow（FLAER）、細胞遺傳學，年輕病人需排除先天骨髓衰竭（Fanconi anemia 的 DEB/MMC 斷裂試驗、telomere 長度）。
治療：年輕且有 HLA 相合手足者首選異體移植；其他以 ATG＋cyclosporine（常合併 eltrombopag）免疫抑制治療。苯暴露除造成再生不良外也增加 AML 風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易把取樣過淺（皮質下）的脂肪骨髓誤判為再生不良；需足夠長度的骨髓切片並評估深部小樑間區域，另要排除保留異常巨核細胞的 hypocellular MDS。

quiz.q: 此骨髓切片的主要異常為何？除了形態外，診斷 aplastic anemia 時應加做哪項流式檢查？
quiz.a: 極度低細胞性骨髓（脂肪取代造血組織）；PNH clone 檢測（FLAER flow cytometry）

15327.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞的細胞質內擠滿許多 2–4 µm 的小型卵圓形酵母菌，菌體周圍有透明暈圈（halo），並有偏心深染的核質；B 圖另以特殊染色（可能為 PAS）將菌體染成洋紅色，符合 HIV 病人的播散性組織漿菌症（histoplasmosis）。
features: Panel A (Wright-Giemsa): macrophage with foamy cytoplasm containing numerous small (2–4 µm) oval yeast forms
Yeasts show a crescent of basophilic cytoplasm/nucleus at one pole surrounded by a clear, unstained halo
Some organisms appear extracellular near the ruptured macrophage
Panel B (special stain, likely PAS): uniformly sized magenta oval yeasts clustered within and around macrophages, highlighting the cell wall
Background: granulocytic precursors, lymphocytes and red cells without other organisms
15327.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (panel A) shows macrophages distended by numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular yeasts measuring about 2–4 µm, each with a polar crescent of basophilic material surrounded by a clear halo, with a few organisms lying free. A special stain (panel B, likely PAS) highlights the yeast cell walls as magenta oval forms within and adjacent to macrophages. No kinetoplast or capsule thickening is identified. In an HIV-positive patient with a CD4 count of 47/µL, findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum); urine/serum antigen and fungal culture confirm the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a cell wall, so they are PAS/GMS negative, whereas Histoplasma yeasts have no kinetoplast and stain with PAS/GMS.
T. marneffei yeasts divide by binary fission with a central transverse septum and some elongated sausage forms, rather than narrow-based budding, in patients from Southeast Asia.
Cryptococcus is larger (4–10 µm) and more variable in size with a thick mucicarminophilic capsule and narrow-based budding.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and PAS negative, and Pneumocystis cysts are cup-shaped without intracellular budding yeast morphology.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis in HIV — macrophages filled with small 2–4 µm oval intracellular yeasts with clear halos, PAS-positive walls
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨噬細胞內帶透明暈的小酵母菌問「是 Histoplasma 還是 Leishmania？」答 Histoplasma：無 kinetoplast、細胞壁 PAS/GMS 陽性。
Wright-Giemsa 下的「halo」是細胞壁不著色所致，並非莢膜；Cryptococcus 才有厚莢膜（mucicarmine 陽性）且菌體較大、大小不一。
診斷：尿液/血清 Histoplasma antigen 在播散性感染敏感度高，可與 Blastomyces、Talaromyces 等交叉反應；確診靠培養或組織染色。
治療：中重度播散性感染以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，再以 itraconazole 維持；晚期 HIV 病人也需注意合併 HLH。台灣須優先鑑別 Talaromyces marneffei。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Leishmania amastigotes 混淆：Leishmania 有核與棒狀 kinetoplast、無細胞壁（PAS/GMS 陰性）；Histoplasma 無 kinetoplast、有透明暈且 PAS/GMS 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖 A 巨噬細胞內帶透明暈的小圓形微生物最可能是什麼？哪一項非侵入性檢查對播散性感染敏感度高？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum 酵母菌；尿液（或血清）Histoplasma antigen

15199.recognize_zh: 背部、腰部與臀部可見多發、邊界清楚但形狀不規則的紅斑斑塊（patch）與薄斑塊（thin plaque），分布於平常不曬太陽的「泳衣區」，符合蕈狀肉芽腫（mycosis fungoides）早期皮膚表現。
features: Multiple erythematous patches and thin plaques over the back, flanks and buttocks
Lesions are irregular to annular/arcuate with sharp borders and variable size
Predilection for sun-protected (bathing-trunk) areas, with intervening uninvolved skin
No tumors, ulceration or nodules visible
Clinical photograph; no histology shown
15199.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the posterior trunk shows numerous well-demarcated, irregularly shaped erythematous patches and thin plaques distributed over the back, flanks and buttocks, with a predilection for sun-protected skin. No tumors or ulcerated lesions are seen in this field. The extent of patch/plaque disease without tumors corresponds to the stage IB designation in the figure legend (patches/plaques involving 10% or more of body surface area). Findings are consistent with patch/plaque-stage mycosis fungoides; confirmation requires skin biopsy showing epidermotropic atypical T cells, supported by immunophenotype and TCR clonality studies.

ddx.vs: These are clinically similar but biopsy shows spongiosis or psoriasiform hyperplasia without epidermotropic atypical cerebriform lymphocytes, Pautrier microabscesses or a clonal TCR rearrangement.
Large-plaque parapsoriasis overlaps clinically and may be early MF; distinction rests on histologic atypia, lining of basal epidermis by haloed lymphocytes, and T-cell clonality.
Annular lesions of tinea have scaly advancing edges and show fungal hyphae on KOH or PAS stain rather than a lymphoid infiltrate.
Sezary syndrome presents with generalized erythroderma (≥80% BSA) plus a leukemic Sezary cell burden, rather than discrete patches with spared skin.

exam.answer_en: Mycosis fungoides, patch/plaque stage (IB) — multiple sharply demarcated erythematous patches and thin plaques in sun-protected skin
pearls_zh: 考法：非顯微鏡臨床照片；考官問「分布有何特點？屬哪一期？」答：好發於不曬太陽的 bathing-trunk 區，patch/plaque ≥10% 體表面積、無腫瘤→T2，stage IB。
ISCL/EORTC 分期：T1 為 patch/plaque <10% BSA（IA），T2 為 ≥10%（IB），T3 為 ≥1 個直徑 ≥1 cm 的腫瘤（IIB），T4 為紅皮症 ≥80% BSA。
病理：epidermotropism、Pautrier microabscesses、表皮基底層排列的帶暈淋巴球；表型常為 CD4+ 並失去 CD7、CD26，TCR 基因重排可支持克隆性。
早期治療以皮膚導向為主：局部類固醇、nbUVB 或 PUVA 光療、topical mechlorethamine；早期病人多數預後良好。
exam.pitfall_zh: 早期 MF 最常被當成濕疹、乾癬或 parapsoriasis 治療多年；持續不癒、位於非曝曬區的斑塊應停用局部類固醇後做多點切片，必要時重複切片。

quiz.q: 此病人多發 patch/薄 plaque 佔體表面積 ≥10% 且無腫瘤，依 ISCL/EORTC 屬哪一期？
quiz.a: T2（stage IB）mycosis fungoides

15071.recognize_zh: 大腸癌接受 oxaliplatin/5-FU 化療 6 年後出現：周邊血可見有核紅血球與大型不典型細胞、骨髓抹片充滿大型且核形不規則／多核的紅血球前驅細胞（dyserythropoiesis），加上複雜核型（D），符合治療相關骨髓分化不良症候群（therapy-related MDS）合併複雜染色體異常。
features: Panel A (PB): circulating nucleated red cells and a larger immature cell with irregular nucleus; anisopoikilocytosis
Panels B-C (BM aspirate): numerous erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and megaloblastoid chromatin
Large bizarre/multinucleated erythroid precursors with nuclear irregularity (panel C and inset)
Dysplastic granulocytic forms with abnormal nuclear segmentation in the background
Panel D: G-banded karyotype with multiple numerical and structural abnormalities (complex karyotype)
15071.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with circulating nucleated red cells and occasional large immature mononuclear cells. The bone marrow aspirate is cellular with a prominent erythroid population showing marked dyserythropoiesis, including megaloblastoid maturation, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, nuclear irregularity, and large multinucleated forms; dysplastic granulocytes are also present. The accompanying G-banded karyotype shows multiple numerical and structural abnormalities, although chromosome-level detail is limited at this resolution. The blast percentage cannot be reliably estimated from these fields. In a patient with prior oxaliplatin/fluorouracil exposure, findings are consistent with a therapy-related myelodysplastic neoplasm with complex karyotype; erythroid-predominant AML should be excluded by a formal differential count.

ddx.vs: Requires >80% erythroid precursors with >=30% proerythroblasts on a formal count, which cannot be established from selected fields and would reclassify the case.
Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils but a normal karyotype and response to vitamin replacement.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters of non-hematopoietic cells that are cytokeratin/CDX2 positive, unlike the discohesive erythroid precursors here.

ddx.dx: Toxic dyserythropoiesis from chemotherapy or alcohol
ddx.vs: Transient drug-related dysplasia lacks a clonal complex karyotype and resolves after the exposure is removed.

13855.recognize_zh: 高倍下五個中型細胞，核圓至卵圓、偏心，胞質布滿紫色異染性顆粒但分布不均，部分區域顆粒稀疏或有小空泡，顆粒並散落於細胞周圍；這些是非典型肥大細胞，符合肥大細胞白血病。
features: Five intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with moderate cytoplasm
Round to oval, sometimes eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin partly obscured by granules
Purple-violet metachromatic granules of uneven distribution, with hypogranular zones and small vacuoles
Granules scattered into the adjacent background around at least one cell
No nuclear segmentation; background red cells unremarkable
13855.describe_en: High-power smear shows several intermediate-sized cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate cytoplasm containing purple metachromatic granules that are unevenly distributed, with hypogranular areas, small vacuoles and dispersed extracellular granules. Nuclei are non-segmented. These features are those of atypical mast cells. Findings are consistent with mast cell leukemia in the appropriate context; confirmation by tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunophenotyping, serum tryptase and KIT D816V analysis is recommended.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented nuclei obscured by coarse granules and are CD117-negative, CD123-positive.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic red-purple granules with a Golgi zone and strong MPO positivity, and APL cells often contain Auer rods.
Monocytes have folded nuclei, gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and are nonspecific esterase positive and tryptase negative.

exam.answer_en: Mast cell leukemia — atypical mast cells with round/oval eccentric nuclei, unevenly distributed metachromatic granules, hypogranular areas and vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：一群顆粒分布不均、部分低顆粒的中型細胞，問「是正常肥大細胞還是非典型肥大細胞」；低顆粒、核偏心或雙葉、胞質延長屬非典型。
細胞化學與 IHC：肥大細胞 toluidine blue 異染性陽性，chloroacetate esterase 陽性、MPO 陰性；tryptase 與 CD117 陽性，CD25 異常表現支持腫瘤性。
血清 tryptase 持續 > 20 ng/mL 是 systemic mastocytosis 的次要診斷條件；MCL 病人通常明顯升高。
侵犯器官表現（C-findings）如血球減少、肝功能異常合併腹水、骨溶解、脾功能亢進與吸收不良，是 aggressive SM/MCL 需治療的依據。
exam.pitfall_zh: 顆粒分布不均的肥大細胞易被當成 APL 的前骨髓細胞；肥大細胞顆粒異染性、MPO 陰性且無 Auer rod，APL 則 MPO 強陽性並常有 DIC。

quiz.q: 這些顆粒不均的細胞與 APL 前骨髓細胞，用哪一個細胞化學染色最容易區分？
quiz.a: MPO（肥大細胞陰性、APL 強陽性）；亦可用 tryptase IHC

13023.recognize_zh: 中性球的細胞質內可見多根細長、紡錘狀的淡紫色桿菌，視野中幾乎沒有血小板；在脾臟切除並被狗舔傷口的病人身上，這提示犬咬二氧化碳嗜纖維菌（Capnocytophaga canimorsus）敗血症合併 DIC。
features: Neutrophil containing multiple slender, fusiform, rod-shaped bacilli in the cytoplasm
Bacilli are pale purple and scattered around the nuclear lobes
Neutrophil nucleus with two to three dense lobes; cytoplasm without obvious toxic vacuolation
Absence of platelets in the field, consistent with severe thrombocytopenia
Red cells largely normocytic; a small dark dot near the upper edge may represent a Howell-Jolly body
13023.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil containing numerous slender, fusiform, intracytoplasmic bacilli. Platelets are virtually absent in the field. Red cells are largely unremarkable; a small dense inclusion near the upper edge may represent a Howell-Jolly body, though it is not definitive at this resolution. Intraleukocytic bacteria on a routine smear indicate high-grade bacteremia, and in an asplenic patient with dog-exposure these fusiform bacilli are consistent with Capnocytophaga canimorsus sepsis with disseminated intravascular coagulation; blood cultures with prolonged incubation are required for identification.

ddx.vs: Anaplasma forms dense stippled intracytoplasmic clusters (morulae) rather than discrete individual elongated rods.
Döhle bodies are pale-blue amorphous cytoplasmic patches and toxic granules are coarse dots, not linear fusiform rods.
These can also be engulfed, so separation requires Gram stain and culture rather than morphology.
Contaminants lie extracellularly or on top of cells in different focal planes, whereas these rods are within the neutrophil cytoplasm.

12895.recognize_zh: 左圖可見三團緊密聚集、互相擠壓成多角形的中性球（leukoagglutination），自動血球計數儀可能將其誤判為血小板團塊或漏計白血球；右圖另一區只剩少數被拉扯的白血球，顯示白血球數被假性降低。
features: Left: three tight clusters of mature segmented neutrophils molded against each other
Left: individual neutrophils show normal lobation; background red cells and scattered platelets
Right: another area with few leukocytes, including stretched/smeared neutrophil forms
Right: red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
No blasts or intracellular organisms identified
12895.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows multiple tight aggregates of mature segmented neutrophils with nuclear molding, while other areas contain only sparse, partly smeared leukocytes. Red cells and platelets are otherwise unremarkable, and no blasts or organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with in vitro leukoagglutination (neutrophil clumping), commonly EDTA-dependent and occasionally associated with autoimmune or inflammatory disease, which can cause a spurious decrease in the automated white cell count and interference flags misreported as platelet clumps; repeating the count on a citrate- or heparin-anticoagulated sample, or a manual count, is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps are aggregates of small anucleate granular fragments, not nucleated segmented neutrophils.
True neutropenia shows uniformly few neutrophils across the smear without clusters, and persists with alternative anticoagulants.

ddx.dx: Tumor cell clusters or cohesive malignant cells
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters consist of large atypical cells with high N:C ratios and nucleoli rather than mature lobated neutrophils.
Satellitism shows platelets rimming individual neutrophils rather than neutrophils adhering to each other.

11295.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆中型母細胞樣細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻，胞質淡藍無顆粒，一顆胞質較多且偏心；本張型態不具特異性、未見偽足，需靠流式（CD4、CD56、CD123）才能確認 BPDCN。
features: Two medium-sized blast-like cells with round to oval nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Upper cell with moderate eccentric pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Lower cell smaller with scant cytoplasm and slightly irregular nucleus
No granules, Auer rods or pseudopods; background red cells and few platelets
11295.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two circulating medium-sized blast-like cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant to moderate agranular pale blue cytoplasm; one cell has eccentric cytoplasm. Auer rods, granules and the characteristic pseudopod-like cytoplasmic tails are not appreciated in this field. Red cells and platelets show no specific abnormality. The morphology is nonspecific for an agranular blast population and, in context, is compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, which requires immunophenotypic confirmation (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4, TCL1).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts look similar but express CD34, CD13/CD33 and CD117 without the CD4+CD56+CD123 bright plasmacytoid dendritic cell phenotype.
Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive with B or T lineage markers, whereas BPDCN is usually TdT-negative or weak and CD123/TCF4 positive.
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and condensed chromatin, lacking the blastic fine chromatin.

5855.recognize_zh: 組織中密集浸潤的小淋巴球與大量核偏位、細胞質嗜酸性的漿細胞樣細胞，環繞一個淡粉紅色、細空泡狀、核稀少的結構（可能為神經束或沉積物）排列；以小細胞加漿細胞分化為主，符合硬腦膜邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Dense diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular dark nuclei
Numerous plasmacytoid cells and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm
Cells arranged concentrically around a central pale pink, finely vacuolated structure with sparse spindle nuclei (possibly a nerve twig or deposited material)
Scattered small thin-walled vessels within the infiltrate
No large transformed cells, necrosis or mitotic activity evident in this field
5855.describe_en: Tissue section shows a dense infiltrate of small lymphoid cells admixed with numerous plasmacytoid cells and plasma cells bearing eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm, arranged concentrically around a central pale, finely vacuolated eosinophilic structure with sparse spindle nuclei. The nature of the central structure (nerve twig versus deposited material such as amyloid) cannot be determined on this H&E image alone. Large transformed cells are not a prominent feature. In the dural setting, the findings are consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation; immunophenotyping (CD20+, CD5-, CD10-, cyclin D1-) and light chain restriction should be demonstrated, and a Congo red stain may be useful.

ddx.vs: It contains EMA/SSTR2A-positive meningothelial whorls and a polytypic lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate without light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: IgG4-related disease or idiopathic hypertrophic pachymeningitis
ddx.vs: These show storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis and polytypic IgG4-rich plasma cells rather than a clonal B-cell population.
Plasmacytoma lacks a significant CD20-positive B-cell component, and LPL typically involves marrow with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the CNS
ddx.vs: Primary CNS DLBCL is parenchymal and angiocentric with sheets of large cells, unlike the small-cell dural infiltrate here.

3743.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的顆粒（particle）幾乎全由脂肪空泡、梭形基質細胞與纖維狀網架組成，缺乏密集的造血細胞群，呈現低細胞性、以基質為主的骨髓，符合移植後植入失敗（graft failure）的表現。
features: Low-power marrow particles composed of abundant fat vacuoles and stromal meshwork
Spindle-shaped stromal cells and fibrillary strands radiating from the particle
Scattered histiocytes and small dark cells without organized hematopoietic islands
Markedly reduced hematopoietic precursors relative to fat
Low magnification limits identification of individual cell types
3743.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows particles consisting predominantly of adipocytes and a stromal meshwork of spindle cells and fibrillary strands, with scattered histiocytes and only sparse hematopoietic cells. No dense hematopoietic islands or megakaryocytes are appreciated at this magnification. Findings indicate a markedly hypocellular, stroma-predominant marrow; in a post-transplant patient this is consistent with graft failure, and should be correlated with blood counts, trephine cellularity and donor chimerism.

ddx.vs: Aspirate appearance is identical; the distinction is clinical, based on transplant history and chimerism rather than morphology.
Myelofibrosis yields scant, poorly spread aspirates and biopsy shows reticulin/collagen fibrosis with atypical megakaryocytes, rather than fat-rich particles.
Relapse shows blasts and recipient chimerism, which are not evident in this field.

1823.recognize_zh: 中央兩顆嗜中性球周圍聚集了許多小血小板，形成血小板衛星現象與小團聚集（platelet satellitism/clumping），其他區域幾乎沒有游離血小板，是 EDTA 引起假性血小板低下（pseudothrombocytopenia）的線索；紅血球上的折光小泡為乾燥假影。
features: Platelets clustered around and adherent to two neutrophils (platelet satellitism) with small loose platelet aggregates
Few free-lying single platelets elsewhere in the field
Neutrophils otherwise morphologically unremarkable; a small lymphocyte at the lower right
Red cells with refractile clear inclusions and crenation from drying artifact
No schistocytes or giant platelets identified
1823.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous platelets gathered around two neutrophils, forming platelet satellitism with small loose aggregates, while few free platelets are present elsewhere in the field. The neutrophils and a nearby lymphocyte are unremarkable, and red cells show refractile drying artifact without schistocytes. Platelet clumping and satellitism cause analyzers to undercount platelets. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia; a repeat count from a citrate- or heparin-anticoagulated sample, or a finger-stick smear, is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows uniformly sparse platelets without aggregates or neutrophil rosetting, and the low count persists in citrate tubes.
Clotting-related clumps are large fibrin-containing aggregates at the feathered edge without neutrophil satellitism, and recur with any anticoagulant only if collection is poor.
Bacteria are uniform rods/cocci and precipitate is refractile and extracellular, whereas platelets have a granular purple center and pale hyalomere.

exam.answer_en: EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia — platelet satellitism around neutrophils with small platelet aggregates
pearls_zh: 考法：儀器報告血小板低但病人無出血，考官給此圖問「血小板真的低嗎？」；答 pseudothrombocytopenia，指出嗜中性球周圍的 platelet satellitism 與聚集。
機轉：EDTA 改變 GPIIb/IIIa 構形暴露隱藏抗原，自體抗體結合後使血小板聚集；satellitism 則由抗體橋接血小板與嗜中性球（FcγRIII）形成。
處理：改用 citrate 或 heparin 抗凝管重抽並立即計數，或 finger-stick 直接抹片；無臨床意義，不需治療，但須在病歷註記避免不必要的輸注或骨髓檢查。
驗室流程重點：任何非預期的血小板低下都應先看血片 feathered edge 是否有聚集，再發報告。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤當作真正血小板低下（如 ITP）而給予治療；真性低下血片上血小板均勻稀少、無聚集或環繞白血球，且在 citrate 管中數值仍低。

quiz.q: 此血片中血小板圍繞嗜中性球排列，稱為什麼現象？下一步應如何確認真實血小板數？
quiz.a: Platelet satellitism（EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia）；改用 citrate（或 heparin）抗凝管重新計數

1311.recognize_zh: 周邊血液有多個母細胞，胞質藍、部分邊緣有泡狀突起或空泡化，核偏一側或有凹陷；另可見一顆有核紅血球與一個大型灰藍色血小板，這些組合（巨核母細胞＋大血小板）在唐氏症病童提示 ML-DS。
features: Multiple circulating medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and fine to slightly condensed chromatin
Basophilic cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs and irregular or vacuolated margins in several blasts
Eccentric, indented or kidney-shaped nuclei in some blasts
Circulating nucleated red cell and a large, pale-gray giant platelet
Red cells mostly normocytic with mild anisopoikilocytosis
1311.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating blasts. The blasts are medium-sized with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei, and basophilic agranular cytoplasm that frequently shows cytoplasmic blebs and irregular vacuolated borders. A nucleated red blood cell and a giant platelet are also present. The blast morphology favors megakaryoblastic differentiation; in a child with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome, requiring flow cytometric confirmation (CD41, CD61) and GATA1 testing.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable megakaryoblasts; TAM occurs in neonates and resolves spontaneously, whereas ML-DS presents later in early childhood.
Lymphoblasts have smooth cytoplasmic outlines without blebbing and are negative for CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia in non-Down syndrome patients
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps completely, and separation depends on constitutional trisomy 21 with GATA1 mutation versus other drivers such as CBFA2T3::GLIS2 or RBM15::MRTFA.

exam.answer_en: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome — circulating megakaryoblasts with cytoplasmic blebs, a nucleated red cell and a giant platelet
pearls_zh: 考法：這張同時有 megakaryoblasts、有核紅血球與巨大灰藍血小板，考官會問「這些線索共同指向哪一系？」；答 megakaryocytic lineage，唐氏症病童即 ML-DS。
Flow：megakaryoblast 表現 CD41（GPIIb）、CD61（GPIIIa）、CD42b，MPO 與 lymphoid 標記陰性；因常合併骨髓纖維化，抽吸常 dry tap，需靠周邊血 flow 或切片。
TAM 與 ML-DS 皆帶 GATA1 突變；TAM 多在新生兒期自行消退，但部分病童之後會發展為 ML-DS，須定期追蹤血球。
ML-DS 對 cytarabine 高度敏感、預後佳，治療強度可低於一般 AML；而唐氏症兒童的治療相關毒性（感染、黏膜炎）較高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與非唐氏症的 AMKL 混淆：兩者形態相同，但非 DS 的 AMKL 常見 CBFA2T3::GLIS2 或 RBM15::MRTFA 等融合且預後較差，區分靠臨床背景與分子檢查。

quiz.q: 這些帶胞質突起的母細胞以哪兩個 flow 標記最能確認其細胞系？
quiz.a: CD41 與 CD61（亦可 CD42b）

1183.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中紅血球大小與形狀不一，可見多顆淚滴細胞（dacrocytes）與橢圓形細胞，中央另有一顆核質比高、染色質細緻的未成熟單核細胞（疑為芽細胞），淚滴細胞加上幼稚細胞是骨髓纖維化的典型線索。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with several teardrop cells (dacrocytes)
Elliptocytes and occasional fragmented/irregular red cells
Single immature mononuclear cell with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm (blast-like)
Scattered platelets, some large, without clumping
Nucleated red cells not seen in this field
1183.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells and elliptocytes. A single large mononuclear cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm is present, compatible with a circulating blast or immature precursor. Platelets are present and include some large forms. Nucleated red cells are not identified in this field, but the teardrop poikilocytosis with circulating immature cells suggests a leukoerythroblastic picture. Findings are consistent with primary myelofibrosis in the appropriate clinical and marrow biopsy context.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or granulomatous disease infiltrating marrow (myelophthisis)
ddx.vs: Myelophthisic anemia produces the same teardrop and leukoerythroblastic smear; distinction requires marrow biopsy and absence of MPN driver mutations.
Blood morphology is indistinguishable; history of prior PV or ET defines secondary myelofibrosis.
These can show teardrop cells but also show target cells/microcytosis or macro-ovalocytes with hypersegmented neutrophils, without circulating blasts.
Acute leukemia shows many circulating blasts (≥20% in marrow or blood), rather than a rare blast among dacrocytes.

exam.answer_en: Myelofibrosis, peripheral blood — teardrop cells (dacrocytes) with anisopoikilocytosis and a circulating blast-like immature cell
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著淚滴狀紅血球問名稱與機轉；答 dacrocyte，紅血球通過纖維化骨髓或髓外造血的脾臟時變形，配合 NRBC 與未成熟顆粒球即 leukoerythroblastic picture。
看到周邊血 blasts 要計數：PMF 周邊血 blasts ≥1% 是 DIPSS 的不良預後因子；MPN 中 blasts 10–19% 視為 accelerated phase，≥20% 為 blast phase。
骨髓抽吸常 dry tap，須做切片評估 reticulin/collagen 纖維化分級，並檢測 JAK2、CALR、MPL driver mutations。
Post-PV/post-ET myelofibrosis 與 PMF 周邊血表現類似，區分靠先前 PV/ET 病史。
exam.pitfall_zh: 淚滴細胞並非 PMF 專屬：myelophthisis（轉移癌、肉芽腫）、thalassemia、megaloblastic anemia 都可出現；另勿把抹片拉片方向一致的人工淚滴（尾巴朝同一方向）當真。

quiz.q: 圖中淚滴狀紅血球叫什麼？與 NRBC、未成熟顆粒球合併出現時稱為何種血片表現？
quiz.a: Dacrocytes（teardrop cells）；leukoerythroblastic picture（leukoerythroblastosis）

1119.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中淋巴球明顯增多，多為小至中型、細胞質嗜鹼性且部分有細胞質突起（blebs），核形略不規則，符合T細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）。
features: Marked absolute lymphocytosis with numerous small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells
High N:C ratio with a narrow rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Occasional cytoplasmic protrusions/blebs and irregular nuclear outlines
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not reliably resolvable at this magnification
Few smudge-like cells; red cells normochromic with no significant poikilocytosis
1119.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of fairly monomorphous small to intermediate lymphoid cells. The cells have high N:C ratios, basophilic agranular cytoplasm with occasional cytoplasmic blebs, and round to slightly irregular nuclei. Nucleoli cannot be evaluated reliably at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of a mature T-cell leukemia such as T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry and TCL1A/TCL1 rearrangement studies are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin, scant pale cytoplasm without blebs, and numerous smudge cells; immunophenotype is CD5+/CD23+ B-cell.
Sézary cells show cerebriform grooved nuclei and lack the basophilic blebbed cytoplasm and prominent nucleolus of T-PLL.
Morphology may overlap; flow cytometry showing B-cell antigens rather than CD3/CD7 with TCL1 overexpression separates them.

1055.recognize_zh: 視野中有兩顆嗜鹼性球（basophil），胞質塞滿深紫黑色粗顆粒並遮住核，另有一顆嗜中性球；CML 周邊血嗜鹼性球增多是加速期的線索之一，紅血球可見標靶狀、口形與淚滴狀變化。
features: Two basophils with coarse dark purple-black granules overlying and obscuring the nucleus
One segmented neutrophil with fine granules
Red cells with anisopoikilocytosis: target-like and stomatocyte-like forms, a teardrop cell, and occasional crenated cells
Platelets present, some in small clumps, with variably sized forms
1055.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two basophils with abundant coarse dark granules obscuring the nuclei, together with a segmented neutrophil. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with target-like and stomatocyte-like cells, occasional crenated cells, and a teardrop cell; some of the central clearing may be drying artifact. Platelets are present with variable size. In a patient with CML, findings are consistent with basophilia; peripheral basophils >=20% would support accelerated phase.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger, often spindle-shaped with round central nuclei and metachromatic granules that do not overlie the nucleus, and are CD117/tryptase positive.
Toxic granules are finer and dispersed in neutrophils with visible segmented nuclei, rather than large coarse granules obscuring the nucleus.
Reactive basophilia is mild without left-shifted granulocytes, blasts, or BCR::ABL1.

4063.recognize_zh: 真皮內密集的淋巴細胞浸潤呈強烈紅色膜狀免疫染色，包圍但不侵犯染色陰性的附屬器上皮結構；此張為 T 細胞抗原免疫染色，標記名稱未標示，需配合 TCL1 與 T-PLL 臨床背景判讀。
features: Dense, sheet-like dermal infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Strong, crisp membranous red chromogen staining in virtually all infiltrating cells
Negative (blue counterstained) adnexal/ductal epithelium serving as internal control
Perivascular and periadnexal distribution with cuffing around the epithelial structure
Uniform staining intensity suggesting a monotonous population
4063.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen; specific marker not indicated) on a skin biopsy shows a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate with diffuse, strong membranous positivity in nearly all neoplastic cells. The infiltrate surrounds and cuffs a negative adnexal epithelial structure and perivascular spaces. Cytologic detail is limited on this immunostain.
