In the context of a known T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, the diffuse positivity for a T-cell antigen is consistent with cutaneous involvement (leukemia cutis); TCL1 expression would support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: MF shows epidermotropism with CD4+ cells often losing CD7, whereas T-PLL spares the epidermis and expresses TCL1.
Reactive infiltrates are mixed CD4/CD8 with preserved pan-T antigens and lack TCL1 and clonal TRG rearrangement.
CLL cutis is CD20+/CD5+/CD23+ B cells, not a T-cell antigen-positive population.

4063.stain: IHC: T-cell marker (marker not specified), red chromogen

4191.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆淋巴球的細胞核深度分葉成多個花瓣狀，染色質濃縮，胞質嗜鹼性，這就是典型的「花細胞」（flower cell），是成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤的代表形態。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell
Nucleus deeply lobulated into multiple petal-like lobes (flower/cloverleaf shape)
Condensed, clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli
Thin rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Background red cells unremarkable
4191.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical medium-sized lymphocyte with a markedly polylobated, petal-like nucleus, condensed chromatin, no conspicuous nucleoli, and a scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm. Surrounding erythrocytes are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with a 'flower cell' of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation by HTLV-1 serology and a CD4+/CD25+/CD7- immunophenotype is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have a cerebriform nucleus with fine grooves rather than deep clefts separating discrete petal-like lobes, and patients are HTLV-1 negative.
Neutrophils have pink granular cytoplasm and lobes joined by thin chromatin strands, not a basophilic agranular rim.
T-PLL cells usually have a single visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, with TCL1 expression rather than CD25.
CLL cells are B cells (CD5+/CD23+/CD20 dim) and only occasionally show a single notch rather than multilobation.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma — classic 'flower cell' with deeply lobulated petal-like nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：單顆花瓣核淋巴球，問名稱、病毒與相關電解質急症；答 flower cell、HTLV-1、高血鈣。
免疫表型：CD2+ CD3+ CD4+ CD25+，CD7 常陰性；常表現 CCR4 與 FOXP3。
分型（Shimoyama）：acute 與 lymphoma 型屬侵襲性；chronic 與 smoldering 屬 indolent，但 chronic 型有不良因子時處理同侵襲型。
HTLV-1 前病毒於腫瘤細胞呈單株整合，可佐證診斷；抗 CCR4 抗體 mogamulizumab 為治療選項之一。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Sézary cell 或 CLL 的裂核細胞：flower cell 核為多葉花瓣狀而非腦迴狀；需 HTLV-1 抗體與 CD25 表現支持。

quiz.q: 圖中這種細胞的名稱為何？病人最需檢查的血清電解質異常是？
quiz.a: Flower cell（ATLL）；高血鈣（hypercalcemia）

3999.recognize_zh: 這是腹部顯影電腦斷層（CT）橫切面，箭頭指向橫結腸壁明顯增厚、黏膜皺襞水腫，顯影劑夾在增厚皺襞之間形成「手風琴徵象」（accordion sign），符合 C. difficile 偽膜性結腸炎的影像表現。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen at the level of the kidneys
Marked circumferential wall thickening of the transverse colon (arrow)
Contrast trapped between edematous haustral folds producing an accordion pattern
Pericolonic soft-tissue stranding and small amount of free fluid
Normally enhancing kidneys; no discrete mass identified
3999.describe_en: This is a radiologic image rather than a morphologic specimen. Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen demonstrates marked diffuse wall thickening of the transverse colon with edematous haustral folds and trapped enteric contrast producing an accordion sign (arrow), with mild pericolonic stranding and fluid. No discrete mass or abscess is seen. In the clinical setting of a patient receiving therapy for leukemia, the findings are suggestive of Clostridioides difficile (pseudomembranous) colitis, confirmed by stool toxin/PCR testing.

ddx.vs: Typhlitis predominantly involves the cecum and right colon in profoundly neutropenic patients, whereas C. difficile colitis is often pancolonic and is confirmed by stool toxin or PCR testing.
Ischemic colitis typically follows a vascular watershed distribution (splenic flexure, rectosigmoid) and lacks positive C. difficile stool testing.
CMV colitis can look identical on CT and requires biopsy showing viral inclusions or CMV immunostain for diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Leukemic or lymphomatous infiltration of the colon
ddx.vs: Neoplastic infiltration tends to produce more focal, mass-like or asymmetric thickening and is proven by tissue biopsy.

3935.recognize_zh: 雖然標題寫 cytogram，這張其實是周邊血抹片：視野中布滿大型芽細胞（blast），核質比高、染色質細緻、部分可見核仁，數量遠多於紅血球間該有的白血球，符合急性骨髓性白血病（AML）的高白血球症。
features: Numerous large blasts, roughly 2–3 times the diameter of a red cell
High N:C ratio with round to slightly indented or folded nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with small nucleoli visible in some cells
Moderate rim of pale-blue, largely agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods not identified in this field
Few residual normal leukocytes; red cells unremarkable
3935.describe_en: Although titled as a cytogram, this image is a peripheral blood smear rather than an analyzer scatterplot. It shows a marked increase in large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale-blue, largely agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen in this field. Normal leukocytes are rare. Findings are consistent with the blood picture of hyperleukocytosis in acute myeloid leukemia, with lineage assignment requiring cytochemistry (MPO) and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are often smaller with scant cytoplasm and less conspicuous nucleoli, and are MPO-negative with B- or T-lymphoid markers on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells tend to be more pleomorphic with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm and mature B-cell markers (CD20, surface light chain) without CD34.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase-positive with monocytic flow markers.

3615.recognize_zh: 一顆分葉核嗜中性球的細胞質邊緣（箭頭處）有一團深紫藍色、桑椹狀的顆粒性包涵體，即桑椹體（morula）；出現在嗜中性球內指向人類顆粒球無形體症（Anaplasma phagocytophilum，舊稱 human granulocytic ehrlichiosis）。
features: Segmented neutrophil with a basophilic, stippled, mulberry-like cytoplasmic inclusion (morula) at the arrow
Morula is discrete, smaller than a nuclear lobe, and separate from the nucleus
Neutrophil otherwise shows pink granular cytoplasm and trilobed nucleus
Background echinocytes/crenated red cells and a few platelets
3615.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a discrete, basophilic, stippled intracytoplasmic inclusion (arrow) with a mulberry-like appearance, separate from the nuclear lobes. Background red cells show crenation artifact, and platelets appear decreased. Findings are consistent with a morula of an intracellular Anaplasmataceae organism; localization within a neutrophil favors Anaplasma phagocytophilum (human granulocytic anaplasmosis), and PCR confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale blue-gray, homogeneous, and located at the cell periphery, not dark stippled clusters.
Engulfed organisms appear as individual cocci, rods, or budding yeast often within vacuoles rather than a compact granular morula.

ddx.dx: Detached nuclear fragment (drumstick or apoptotic fragment)
ddx.vs: Nuclear fragments have dense homogeneous chromatin matching the nucleus, lacking the fine granular texture of a morula.
Morulae are found predominantly within monocytes rather than neutrophils.

exam.answer_en: Human granulocytic anaplasmosis — neutrophil containing a mulberry-like morula of Anaplasma phagocytophilum
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指中性球細胞質內的桑椹狀包涵體，要答 morula，並依所在細胞推斷菌種：中性球 → A. phagocytophilum，單核球 → E. chaffeensis。
Morula 是細菌在細胞內空泡中形成的微菌落，屬 Anaplasmataceae、絕對細胞內寄生的革蘭陰性菌，經蜱蟲傳播。
典型實驗室表現：血小板低下、白血球低下、肝轉胺酶上升；臨床懷疑時應立即經驗性給 doxycycline，不必等檢驗結果。
抹片敏感度有限，確診首選全血 PCR；A. phagocytophilum 與 Babesia、Lyme 病可由同一種 Ixodes 蜱傳播。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Döhle body 或重疊的血小板；Döhle body 為淡藍均質、貼近細胞膜，血小板位於細胞上方且焦平面不同，morula 則是細胞質內深紫藍色點狀顆粒團。

quiz.q: 中性球內的桑椹狀包涵體叫什麼？最可能的病原與首選治療是？
quiz.a: Morula；Anaplasma phagocytophilum（human granulocytic anaplasmosis），doxycycline。

3487.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓腔被成片的漿細胞樣腫瘤細胞取代，細胞核偏心、卵圓形，部分核仁明顯，細胞質略嗜雙染；左下殘存少量深染的紅血球系前驅細胞，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤廣泛浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheets of neoplastic plasma cells replacing marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula
Eccentric round to oval nuclei; many immature forms with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; interstitial streaming of cells in areas
Scattered mitotic figures
Residual clusters of erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei (lower left)
3487.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a bony trabecula at right. The intertrabecular space is replaced by diffuse sheets of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric oval nuclei, open chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with scattered mitoses. Only small residual clusters of erythroid precursors remain. Fibrosis cannot be assessed on H&E alone and should be evaluated with a reticulin stain. Findings are consistent with extensive involvement by plasma cell myeloma, confirmed by CD138 and light chain/heavy chain (IgD) immunostains.

ddx.vs: LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with mast cells, not monotonous sheets of immature plasma cells, and is CD20 positive with MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with plasmablastic features
ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma has larger immunoblastic cells with high proliferation and often EBER positivity, typically outside a myeloma clinical picture with M-protein and lytic lesions.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with desmoplasia and is cytokeratin positive, whereas myeloma cells are discohesive and CD138/light chain restricted.

3231.recognize_zh: 中央的漿細胞核偏心、核周較淡，細胞質外緣呈洋紅色（magenta）不規則的火焰狀邊緣，即 flame cell；左側另見染色質細緻的不成熟漿細胞，右側為深藍細胞質的漿細胞。
features: Central plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus and abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm shows a pale-blue perinuclear zone and an intensely magenta, ragged peripheral fringe (flame cell)
Adjacent immature plasma cell with larger nucleus, finer chromatin and pale-blue cytoplasm
Right-sided plasma cell with clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing
Maturing granulocyte (band/metamyelocyte) at top; crenated red cells from drying artifact
3231.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several plasma cells, including a flame cell with an eccentric nucleus and abundant cytoplasm whose periphery stains intensely magenta with a frayed border. An adjacent plasma cell has finer chromatin and a larger nucleus, consistent with an immature form, and a third plasma cell shows basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof. A maturing granulocyte and crenated red cells are also present. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with flame cell morphology, a pattern classically associated with IgA myeloma but not specific.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, polytypic and usually perivascular without immature forms, whereas neoplastic cells show atypia and kappa/lambda restriction.

ddx.dx: Mott cell / Russell body plasma cells
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple discrete round pale-blue Russell bodies rather than a diffuse magenta peripheral cytoplasmic fringe.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic granules distributed over the cytoplasm, a paranuclear Golgi zone but a central-ish nucleus with nucleolus, and lack the eccentric clock-face nucleus of plasma cells.
LPL cells are smaller with less cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes, and carry MYD88 L265P rather than showing atypical immature plasma cells.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma with flame cells — plasma cells with magenta frayed peripheral cytoplasm plus immature plasma cells
pearls_zh: 考法：同一視野有 flame cell、不成熟漿細胞、一般漿細胞，考官會逐顆指認並問 flame cell 經典關聯的 isotype：IgA myeloma（但非專一）。
Myeloma 診斷（IMWG）：骨髓 clonal plasma cells ≥10% 或活檢證實 plasmacytoma，加上 CRAB 或 SLiM（骨髓漿細胞 ≥60%、FLC ratio ≥100、MRI >1 處局灶病灶）。
克隆性：flow 或 IHC 看 kappa/lambda 限制；漿細胞常 CD138+、CD38+、CD19−，且可 CD56+（異常表現）。
高風險細胞遺傳：t(4;14)、t(14;16)、del(17p)、1q gain/amp；FISH 應在 CD138 純化漿細胞上做。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Mott cell 混淆；Mott cell 胞質內是多顆分離的圓形 Russell bodies，flame cell 是周邊胞質瀰漫洋紅色火焰狀邊緣。

quiz.q: 中央這顆胞質外緣呈洋紅色火焰狀的細胞叫什麼？傳統上與哪一種 myeloma isotype 相關？
quiz.a: Flame cell；IgA myeloma

3167.recognize_zh: Ommaya引流液抹片中一段分支的細長管狀組織碎片，內有沿長軸排列的橢圓或梭形內皮細胞核，管腔內含紅血球，這是微血管（vessel）碎片，並非腫瘤細胞團。
features: Branching tubular tissue fragment with a Y-shaped bifurcation
Oval to spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei aligned along the long axis of the tube
Homogeneous smooth nuclear chromatin without atypia or mitoses
Red cells lined up within the lumen of one branch
Otherwise sparsely cellular background with scattered red cells
3167.describe_en: Cytospin of fluid from an Ommaya reservoir tap shows a branching tubular fragment lined by bland oval to spindle-shaped nuclei oriented parallel to its long axis, with red cells aligned within the lumen of one branch. The nuclei show no atypia. The background is sparsely cellular. Findings are consistent with a capillary fragment introduced during the tap, an incidental contaminant that should not be mistaken for tumor cell clusters.

ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are three-dimensional aggregates of cells with enlarged pleomorphic nuclei and high N:C ratio, rather than a branching tube with aligned bland nuclei.
Choroid plexus and ependymal cells form cohesive sheets or papillary groups of cuboidal cells with round nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, not tubular spindle-cell structures.
Hyphae are acellular septate or aseptate tubes without nuclei, whereas this structure contains endothelial nuclei and red cells.

2975.recognize_zh: 中央大型巨噬細胞的淡色泡沫狀細胞質內含多顆被吞噬的有核細胞（深染圓核的淋巴球或紅血球母細胞）及紅血球，是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）的典型表現。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Multiple engulfed intact nucleated cells with dense round nuclei (lymphocytes/erythroid precursors) within vacuoles
Engulfed red cells and larger nucleated cell fragments also present
Adjacent monocyte, band neutrophil, lymphocytes and eosinophil
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
2975.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple phagocytosed nucleated cells with dense round nuclei, likely lymphocytes and erythroid precursors, as well as erythrocytes. Surrounding cells include a monocyte, a band neutrophil, lymphocytes and an eosinophil. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, supporting hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis occurs in megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm, not in a histiocyte with a single oval nucleus.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact nucleated cells and red cells.
Engulfed cells are surrounded by clear vacuoles within the macrophage cytoplasm rather than lying on top of the cell.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis — marrow macrophage with vacuolated cytoplasm containing engulfed nucleated cells and red cells, consistent with HLH in context
pearls_zh: 考法：考官要你指出被吞入的有核細胞與紅血球都位於清楚的空泡內，證明是真吞噬而非細胞重疊。
實驗室線索：ferritin 明顯上升、sCD25（soluble IL-2 receptor）上升、高三酸甘油酯、低纖維蛋白原、肝功能異常與全血球減少。
成人 HLH 多為續發性：感染（EBV 最常見）、淋巴瘤（特別是 T/NK 細胞與 IVLBCL）、自體免疫（MAS）；兒童需考慮遺傳性。
評分工具 HScore 可估計成人 HLH 可能性；遺傳性檢查包含 perforin 表現與 CD107a degranulation assay。
Tingible body macrophage 僅含凋亡核碎片，不算噬血現象。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 tingible body macrophage 當成噬血現象；前者只含凋亡核碎片，噬血巨噬細胞則吞入完整的有核細胞與紅血球。

quiz.q: 成人出現此骨髓噬血現象時，最常見的兩類續發原因是什麼？
quiz.a: 感染（尤其 EBV）與惡性腫瘤（尤其 T/NK 細胞淋巴瘤）

2783.recognize_zh: 高倍免疫染色下，右側濾泡內密集的中大型細胞呈清楚的細胞膜棕色陽性（推測 B 細胞標記），左側小淋巴球多為陰性僅零星陽性，界線分明，顯示濾泡由 B 細胞構成。
features: Dense membranous brown staining of intermediate to large cells filling the follicle on the right
Positive cells have round to oval vesicular nuclei with pale cytoplasm
Sharp border with a region of smaller, mostly negative lymphoid and hematopoietic cells on the left
Scattered individual positive cells outside the follicle
No aberrant cytoplasmic or nuclear staining pattern
2783.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunohistochemical stain at high power (marker not labeled; membranous pattern suggests a B-cell marker such as CD20) shows strong membranous staining of the intermediate to large cells composing the follicle. The adjacent smaller cells are largely negative, with only scattered positive cells. The staining confirms a B-cell follicle with a sharp interface against the surrounding marrow. Findings are consistent with a reactive B-cell germinal center; BCL2, CD10 and Ki-67 would further support reactive status.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles show BCL2 expression in germinal center B cells and a low, non-polarized Ki-67 index, unlike reactive germinal centers.
DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large B cells effacing marrow without a circumscribed follicle and mantle.
Hematogones are interstitially scattered CD19+/CD10+/TdT+ precursors and do not form a cohesive follicle of large B cells.

2719.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆大淋巴細胞，細胞質豐富呈淡藍色、邊緣略有稜角，一側含細小紫紅色嗜天青顆粒，核呈凹陷的不規則形；旁邊的嗜中性球可作大小對照，形態為大顆粒淋巴球，配合流式為 NK 細胞增多。
features: Large lymphocyte, larger than the adjacent neutrophil
Low to moderate N:C ratio with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and angular outline
Fine azurophilic granules clustered in the cytoplasm adjacent to the nuclear indentation
Indented, irregular nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin and no nucleoli
Adjacent normal segmented neutrophil; background red cells unremarkable
2719.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and an indented nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin and no visible nucleoli. A normal segmented neutrophil lies adjacent for comparison. This is a large granular lymphocyte; morphology alone cannot determine NK versus T lineage. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, supporting NK-cell lymphocytosis when flow cytometry shows surface CD3-negative, CD16/CD56-positive cells.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells look identical but are surface CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ with clonal TCR rearrangement.
Reactive lymphocytes typically have deeply basophilic cytoplasm at the periphery that scallops around red cells and usually lack prominent azurophilic granules.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia cells are more atypical, with immature chromatin and nucleoli, and are EBV-positive in a clinically fulminant setting.
Monocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dusty granules, vacuoles and folded lacy chromatin, rather than discrete azurophilic granules and condensed lymphoid chromatin.

2527.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量高，許多中型細胞核染色質細緻、胞質藍而無顆粒，屬原始細胞，夾雜顆粒減少的嗜中性球及紅血球前驅細胞，提示 MDS 伴過量原始細胞（MDS-EB）。
features: Hypercellular aspirate smear with numerous intermediate-sized immature cells
Blasts with fine chromatin, round to oval nuclei and scant to moderate agranular blue cytoplasm
Scattered segmented neutrophils, several with pale hypogranular cytoplasm
Occasional erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
Limited image resolution precludes precise blast enumeration
2527.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular specimen with numerous blasts that have fine chromatin, round to oval nuclei and agranular basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with maturing granulocytes, some appearing hypogranular, and scattered erythroid precursors. Auer rods are not evident at this resolution. An accurate blast percentage requires a 500-cell differential count, and dysplasia requires high-power review. Findings are suggestive of myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts; distinction from acute myeloid leukemia depends on the blast count.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation has at least 20% blasts with at least 10% maturing granulocytes, so the manual blast count separates it from MDS-EB.
Hematogones have scant cytoplasm and homogeneous smudgy chromatin with a maturing B-precursor flow pattern, not CD34+/CD117+ myeloblasts.
Lymphoblasts lack granules and Auer rods and are MPO-negative with TdT and lymphoid markers, requiring flow cytometry.

2399.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量豐富，以早幼粒細胞（promyelocyte）與骨髓細胞等顆粒球前驅細胞占多數，但仍一路成熟到桿狀與分節嗜中性球，芽細胞並未明顯成片，這種「同步左移但會成熟」的樣貌符合化療或抑制後恢復中的骨髓。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors
Left shift with numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes (round to oval nuclei, granular cytoplasm, some with paranuclear hof)
Continued maturation to metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils
Occasional larger cells with basophilic cytoplasm; no sheet of agranular blasts
Scattered erythroid precursors and lymphocytes; no dysplastic features evident at this power
2399.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular specimen with marked granulocytic predominance and a left shift, with numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes showing granular cytoplasm and paranuclear hofs. Orderly maturation continues through metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils, and blasts do not form sheets. Erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are present in lesser numbers. Findings are consistent with regenerating (recovering) marrow with a synchronous wave of granulocytic maturation, such as after chemotherapy or G-CSF; a formal blast count and clinical correlation are needed to exclude residual leukemia.

ddx.vs: APL shows a monotonous population of abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei, Auer rod bundles and arrested maturation, whereas recovering marrow shows normal promyelocytes maturing to neutrophils.
Residual AML shows increased agranular blasts (often aberrant immunophenotype on flow), rather than a maturing wave of granulated precursors.
CML shows a myelocyte peak with basophilia, eosinophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes and is BCR::ABL1 positive.

2143.recognize_zh: 綠色箭頭指向染色質細緻、胞質嗜鹼性的芽細胞；紅色箭頭指向一個大型、胞質充滿粗大紫色顆粒而遮蔽核的異常顆粒球系細胞，加上周圍多個芽細胞與核異常的紅血球前驅細胞，呈現芽細胞增加合併多系發育不良。
features: Increased blasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (green arrow)
Large abnormal granulated cell with coarse purple granules obscuring the nucleus (red arrow), suggesting dysplastic granulopoiesis
Erythroid precursors with irregular nuclear contours and megaloblastoid chromatin
Admixed small lymphocytes and maturing myeloid cells
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis
2143.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm (green arrow). A large cell with abundant coarse purple granules obscuring the nucleus (red arrow) represents an abnormally granulated myeloid cell, and several erythroid precursors show irregular nuclear contours and megaloblastoid chromatin. Blast percentage cannot be determined from a single field. In conjunction with ≥20% blasts and dysplasia in ≥50% of cells in at least two lineages, the findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes (multilineage dysplasia).

ddx.vs: APL cells are a predominant population of hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles, rather than scattered granulated cells among agranular blasts.
Distinguished by blast count: MDS-EB has <20% blasts in marrow and blood.

ddx.dx: AML with recurrent genetic abnormality (e.g., NPM1-mutated) with dysplasia
ddx.vs: Multilineage dysplasia alone does not qualify for AML-MRC when a defining NPM1 or biallelic CEBPA mutation is present, so molecular testing is required.
Morphology is similar; classification depends on a history of prior cytotoxic therapy.

2015.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結：多個有生發中心的反應性濾泡（follicular hyperplasia），濾泡周圍與間質中散布許多淡粉紅色的小團類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），部分緊貼甚至侵入生發中心，加上被膜下淡染區，構成弓漿蟲淋巴結炎（Piringer-Kuchinka）的典型三聯徵。
features: Low-power lymph node with intact capsule and perinodal fat
Multiple reactive follicles with enlarged pale germinal centers
Numerous small, pale eosinophilic clusters of epithelioid histiocytes in interfollicular areas
Epithelioid clusters abutting and encroaching on germinal centers
Pale subcapsular/perisinusoidal zones suggestive of monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia
No necrosis or well-formed large granulomas
2015.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows preserved architecture with a thin capsule and follicular hyperplasia with enlarged germinal centers. Numerous small, loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are scattered in the interfollicular areas and encroach upon germinal centers, and pale subcapsular zones suggest monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia. Necrosis and well-formed large granulomas are absent. Findings are consistent with toxoplasma lymphadenitis (Piringer-Kuchinka lymphadenitis), best confirmed with serology.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas are larger, well formed and often necrotizing with giant cells, rather than tiny non-necrotizing epithelioid clusters encroaching on follicles.
Sarcoid granulomas are discrete, tight and confluent, replacing the node, without the florid follicular and monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia of toxoplasmosis.
Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back crowded follicles with attenuated mantles and no tingible-body macrophages, and lacks epithelioid histiocyte clusters.

ddx.dx: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma with epithelioid histiocytes
ddx.vs: NLPHL shows large vague nodules containing LP (popcorn) cells that are CD20+ and CD30-, rather than reactive follicles with polarized germinal centers.

exam.answer_en: Toxoplasma (Piringer-Kuchinka) lymphadenitis — follicular hyperplasia, epithelioid histiocyte clusters encroaching on germinal centers, monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍全景要求說出三聯徵：(1) follicular hyperplasia (2) 小團 epithelioid histiocytes 貼近或侵入生發中心 (3) monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia。
三聯徵對 toxoplasmosis 有高度提示性，但病理報告通常寫「consistent with」，需以 Toxoplasma IgM/IgG 血清學確認。
與其他肉芽腫性淋巴結炎的差別：無壞死、無 Langhans giant cells、無大型融合肉芽腫；若有壞死應轉而考慮 TB、黴菌、cat-scratch disease。
治療：免疫健全且無症狀者多不需治療；重症、免疫抑制或眼部侵犯時使用 pyrimethamine + sulfadiazine（加 leucovorin）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 follicular lymphoma 或 NLPHL：FL 濾泡背靠背、mantle 變薄且無 tingible-body macrophages；此處濾泡為反應性極化並伴隨上皮樣組織球小叢，架構保留。

quiz.q: 說出此圖符合弓漿蟲淋巴結炎的三個組織學特徵。
quiz.a: Follicular hyperplasia、epithelioid histiocyte clusters 侵入生發中心、monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia

1951.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中央一個邊界模糊的淡染區，內含胞質嗜酸性、核圓至卵圓且淡染的類上皮樣細胞及小血管，周圍被密集的小淋巴球包圍；右上角為被膜。此淡染區可能為退化濾泡中增生的濾泡樹突細胞或透明細胞群，需免疫染色確認。
features: Central ill-defined pale-staining zone composed of cells with ovoid vesicular nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Small vessels with plump endothelial cells within and around the pale zone
Scattered small lymphocytes infiltrating the pale zone
Dense surrounding sheet of small, dark lymphocytes
Capsule/perinodal tissue at the upper right
1951.describe_en: Lymph node section shows an ill-defined pale-staining zone composed of cells with ovoid vesicular nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with small vessels and scattered small lymphocytes, and surrounded by a dense population of small lymphocytes. The capsule is present at the upper right. The pale cells may represent a follicular dendritic cell proliferation within a regressed follicle, clusters of clear neoplastic T cells, or epithelioid histiocytes; this cannot be resolved on H&E alone. In context, findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, and CD21/CD23, PD-1/CXCL13 and CD68 immunostains are recommended to characterize the pale zone.

ddx.vs: Granulomas are well circumscribed collections of CD68-positive epithelioid histiocytes, often with giant cells or necrosis, rather than CD21-positive dendritic meshworks around vessels.
Castleman follicles are regressed with onion-skin mantle zones and radially penetrating hyalinized vessels, but lack clonal TFH-phenotype T cells.

ddx.dx: Lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lennert lymphoma has numerous small epithelioid histiocyte clusters throughout the node with a CD8-predominant infiltrate and without expanded FDC meshworks.

1887.recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下，細胞質內可見由多層平行膜片與其間排列規則的核糖體組成的長柱狀結構，即核糖體－板層複合體（ribosome-lamella complex），是毛狀細胞白血病的超微結構特徵之一。
features: Transmission electron micrograph (ultrastructure), not light microscopy
Elongated cylindrical cytoplasmic structure of concentric/parallel lamellae
Regularly spaced ribosomes lining the lamellae (ribosome-lamella complex)
Adjacent nucleus with peripheral heterochromatin
Scattered mitochondria and free ribosomes in surrounding cytoplasm
1887.describe_en: Transmission electron micrograph shows part of a cell with a nucleus on the left and an elongated cytoplasmic inclusion composed of parallel membranous lamellae studded with regularly arranged ribosomes. Several mitochondria are present adjacent to the structure. This represents a ribosome-lamella complex. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia, in which this structure is found in a subset of cases, although it is not entirely specific.

ddx.dx: Rough endoplasmic reticulum stacks (e.g., plasma cells)
ddx.vs: RER forms flattened cisternae with ribosomes on the outer surface only and lacks the tubular cylindrical arrangement of the ribosome-lamella complex.

ddx.dx: Other B-cell lymphomas with rare ribosome-lamella complexes
ddx.vs: RLCs are occasionally reported in other lymphoproliferative disorders, so diagnosis rests on BRAF V600E, CD103/CD25/CD11c/annexin A1 and TRAP rather than ultrastructure alone.

1631.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見淋巴結被膜與其下的被膜下竇，右側有一個淡染的次級濾泡生發中心，內含吞噬凋亡碎片的巨噬細胞（tingible body macrophage），其餘為帶有高內皮小靜脈的斑駁副皮質區，結構完整。
features: Thin fibrous capsule with subcapsular sinus along the top edge
Secondary follicle with a pale germinal center containing scattered tingible body macrophages (right)
A second ill-defined pale follicle-like area beneath the capsule (upper left)
Paracortex with a mottled appearance from pale histiocytes/dendritic cells and high endothelial venules
Preserved nodal architecture without effacement
1631.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows an intact capsule and subcapsular sinus. The cortex contains a secondary follicle with a pale germinal center and scattered tingible body macrophages, while the underlying paracortex has a mottled appearance with high endothelial venules and interspersed pale cells. Nodal architecture is preserved, with no diffuse effacement or monotonous infiltrate. Findings are consistent with normal/reactive lymph node cortex and paracortex.

ddx.vs: FL shows crowded back-to-back follicles lacking tingible body macrophages and polarization, often extending through the capsule, whereas this node has few follicles with tingible body macrophages and a preserved paracortex.
Interfollicular Hodgkin lymphoma contains Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells in a mixed inflammatory background, which should be sought at high power but are not evident here.
Paracortical hyperplasia expands the T zone with numerous immunoblasts and compresses follicles, a quantitative distinction requiring comparison with the whole node.

1439.recognize_zh: 雙格富細胞骨髓抹片，顆粒球與紅系前驅細胞都有，左下有一個大型巨核細胞；箭頭指出核形不規則或核質成熟不同步的前驅細胞。此 Wright 染色只能看出輕度異型性，環狀鐵粒母細胞必須靠鐵染色證實，本圖無法直接看出。
features: Two-panel composite of cellular bone marrow aspirate fields
Trilineage hematopoiesis with abundant granulocytic precursors at all stages
Erythroid precursors present, some with irregular nuclear contours or asynchronous maturation (arrows)
Large megakaryocyte in the left panel without obvious hypolobation at this resolution
No Prussian blue iron stain shown; ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed
1439.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate composite shows a cellular specimen with trilineage hematopoiesis, including granulocytic precursors at all stages, erythroid precursors and a large megakaryocyte. Arrows highlight precursor cells with irregular nuclear contours or asynchronous nuclear-cytoplasmic maturation, suggesting mild dysplasia, although resolution limits detailed assessment. Blasts are not obviously increased. Ring sideroblasts cannot be evaluated on this Romanowsky stain; a Prussian blue stain showing at least 15% ring sideroblasts (or at least 5% with SF3B1 mutation) is required for MDS with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: A reactive marrow shows orderly maturation without persistent dysplasia or ring sideroblasts and lacks clonal abnormalities.
Congenital forms present early in life with microcytic ring sideroblasts and germline ALAS2 or related mutations rather than clonal SF3B1 mutation.
Separation depends on ring sideroblast percentage and SF3B1 status, which are not visible on this stain.

1503.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆中型淋巴樣細胞，淡灰藍色細胞質沿整個細胞周圍伸出細毛狀突起（circumferential hairy projections），細胞核圓、染色質均勻細緻且無明顯核仁，是毛狀細胞白血病的典型毛狀細胞。
features: Single medium-sized lymphoid cell, about 1.5 times the diameter of a red cell
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
Round, centrally placed nucleus
Homogeneous, finely granular chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate N:C ratio; no cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells without specific abnormality
1503.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single medium-sized lymphoid cell with moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm bearing fine, circumferential hair-like projections. The nucleus is round with homogeneous, finely granular chromatin and no conspicuous nucleolus. Background red cells are unremarkable. This is a classic hairy cell, and the findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent nucleolus like prolymphocytes and are CD25 and CD123 negative without BRAF V600E.
Villous lymphocytes show short polar (bipolar) projections and more condensed chromatin rather than circumferential hairs.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Villous cells have broad-based uneven projections and are usually CD25 and CD123 negative.

ddx.dx: Drying artifact in a normal lymphocyte or monocyte
ddx.vs: Artifactual projections are irregular and occur on multiple cell types, whereas hairy cells have fine regular circumferential hairs with a spongy chromatin pattern.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — lymphoid cell with circumferential fine hairy cytoplasmic projections and round nucleus without nucleolus
pearls_zh: 考法：周邊血指毛狀細胞問診斷；需同時提到 CBC 常見 pancytopenia 伴 monocytopenia，以及脾腫大。
Flow：CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 強陽性；IHC annexin A1、TRAP 陽性；BRAF V600E mutation 幾乎見於所有 classic HCL。
骨髓抽吸常 dry tap（reticulin fibrosis），需切片評估；切片呈 fried-egg 外觀。
治療：purine analog（cladribine 或 pentostatin）±rituximab；復發難治可考慮 BRAF inhibitor。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 HCL variant（WHO 5th 改稱 splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli）；後者有明顯核仁、白血球高、CD25−、無 BRAF V600E。

quiz.q: 此細胞最可能的診斷？幾乎所有病例帶有哪個突變？
quiz.a: Hairy cell leukemia；BRAF V600E

95.recognize_zh: 鐵染色（Prussian blue）可見大量紅血球母細胞的鐵顆粒環繞核周排列成環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts），加上抹片中多核與核型不規則的紅系前驅細胞、低顆粒嗜中性球及卵圓形巨紅血球，指向紅系與顆粒系皆有發育不良的 MDS-RS-MLD；CD34 染色未見母細胞增加。
features: Prussian blue stain: numerous erythroid precursors with coarse iron granules arranged in a perinuclear ring (ring sideroblasts)
Dyserythropoiesis on aspirate: multinucleated (trinucleate) erythroblast, irregular/lobulated nuclear contours, megaloblastoid nuclear chromatin
Dysgranulopoiesis: hypogranular neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation
Hypercellular marrow biopsy with erythroid predominance, many immature erythroid precursors, and scattered megakaryocytes including small hypolobated forms
Peripheral blood: oval macrocytes with anisocytosis; normal-appearing platelets
CD34 IHC highlights vessels and occasional megakaryocytes without an increase in CD34+ blasts; MRI shows a frontal lobe mass with edema (the PCNSL prompting staging)
95.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows macrocytic anemia with oval macrocytes and anisocytosis, with occasional hypogranular neutrophils. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular for age with erythroid predominance, many immature erythroid precursors, and megakaryocytes that include small hypolobated forms; no lymphoma infiltrate is identified in the sections shown. The aspirate shows dyserythropoiesis (multinucleated and irregularly lobulated erythroblasts with megaloblastoid chromatin) and dysgranulopoiesis (hypogranular, abnormally segmented neutrophils). The iron stain demonstrates numerous ring sideroblasts, and CD34 immunohistochemistry shows no increase in blasts. Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia (MDS-RS-MLD); the brain MRI documents the separate primary CNS lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Congenital or acquired non-neoplastic sideroblastic anemia (copper deficiency, zinc toxicity, alcohol, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts from toxic/nutritional causes usually lack granulocytic dysplasia and SF3B1 mutation, and copper deficiency often shows cytoplasmic vacuoles in precursors with a history of zinc exposure.
Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant bands and hypersegmented neutrophils but not abundant ring sideroblasts, and it corrects with vitamin replacement.

ddx.dx: MDS with excess blasts or AML with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: These require increased myeloblasts (>=5% marrow / >=20%), whereas CD34 staining here shows no blast increase.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by the patient's DLBCL
ddx.vs: Lymphoma involvement would show sheets or aggregates of large atypical B cells (CD20+), which are not seen in these sections.

95.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, Prussian blue, IHC: CD34

exam.answer_en: MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia (MDS-RS-MLD) — Prussian blue ring sideroblasts plus dyserythropoiesis and hypogranular neutrophils, no blast increase; no PCNSL in marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：鐵染色中考官會指核周一圈藍色鐵顆粒的紅血球母細胞問「這是什麼」；ring sideroblast 定義為 ≥5 顆鐵顆粒環繞核周 ≥1/3。
必考分子：SF3B1 突變與 ring sideroblasts 高度相關；WHO 5th 以 SF3B1 突變定義 MDS-SF3B1（低母細胞），RS 只在未驗 SF3B1 時作為替代依據。
Multilineage 看的是紅系以外的系列：本例有 hypogranular、分葉異常嗜中性球與小型低分葉巨核細胞，所以不是單系（SLD）。
這是 PCNSL 分期骨髓：要確認沒有淋巴瘤浸潤，同時報告意外發現的第二個骨髓腫瘤，兩者治療與預後各自評估。
治療連結：低風險、輸血依賴的 MDS-RS 貧血可考慮 luspatercept；CD34 IHC 用來估計母細胞以排除 excess blasts。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為非克隆性鐵粒母細胞貧血（酒精、isoniazid、銅缺乏/鋅過量）或 B12/葉酸缺乏的巨母紅血球變化；需先排除這些原因並查 SF3B1 與染色體。

quiz.q: 鐵染色中核周環狀排列藍色顆粒的紅血球前驅細胞稱為什麼？最常相關的基因突變是？
quiz.a: Ring sideroblast；SF3B1 突變

62751.recognize_zh: 流式圖顯示擴增的 CD3+CD8+CD57+ T 細胞（插圖為具嗜天青顆粒的大顆粒淋巴球），代表 T-LGL；組織切片與抹片則有大型非典型淋巴細胞，CD22 陽性、EBER 大量核陽性，同時可見吞噬血球的組織球（CD163 陽性），顯示同一病人併發 EBV 陽性 DLBCL 與噬血症候群（HLH）。
features: Flow cytometry (A-C): CD3+ T cells ~28% of events; most CD3+ cells are CD8+, with a CD3+CD8+CD57+ population of ~13% of total, consistent with a T-LGL expansion; inset shows a large granular lymphocyte
H&E (D): sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli admixed with erythroid cells
Wright-Giemsa (E): very large atypical cell with fine chromatin, nucleoli and vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm
CD22 (F): membranous positivity of large cells, supporting B lineage; EBER ISH (G): numerous positive nuclei
Aspirate (H): macrophage with phagocytosed red cells/nucleated cells (hemophagocytosis); CD163 (I): increased large histiocytes
62751.describe_en: Peripheral blood flow cytometry demonstrates an expanded CD3+CD8+CD57+ T-cell population, and a large granular lymphocyte with azurophilic granules is illustrated, consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia. Bone marrow sections and smears show infiltration by large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and vacuolated cytoplasm that express CD22 and are positive for EBER in situ hybridization. In addition, macrophages with engulfed hematopoietic cells are present and CD163 highlights increased histiocytes. Findings are consistent with EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis arising in a patient with T-LGL leukemia, reflecting underlying immune dysregulation.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGL expansions (e.g., post-viral) are transient and polyclonal, whereas T-LGL leukemia shows persistent clonal TR rearrangement and often STAT3 mutation.

ddx.dx: Chronic active EBV disease or EBV-positive T/NK lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: In these, EBER localizes to CD3/CD56-positive T or NK cells, whereas here the EBER-positive large cells are CD22-positive B cells.
EBV+ cHL has scattered CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than sheets of CD22+ large B cells.
Primary HLH shows hemophagocytosis and CD163+ histiocytes but no atypical EBER-positive large B-cell infiltrate.

62751.stain: H&E, Wright-Giemsa, IHC: CD22, CD163, ISH: EBER; flow

60575.recognize_zh: 這是螢光原位雜交（FISH）與細胞遺傳學合成圖：A 圖多個間期細胞核內布滿大量散在、成團的訊號，像「煙火」一樣；B 圖中期染色體周圍散布許多訊號；C 圖的中期分裂相可見大量微小的雙微小體（double minutes）；代表 MYC 基因擴增。
features: Panel A: interphase FISH with numerous nuclei containing innumerable scattered and clustered red/green (yellow fusion) signals, a 'fireworks' pattern of gene amplification
Panel A: signal burden varies between nuclei, with some cells showing few signals and others dense confluent clusters
Panel B: metaphase FISH with many signals dispersed around and between chromosomes rather than on a single chromosomal locus
Panel C: G-banded/DAPI-inverted metaphase with numerous tiny paired dot-like chromatin bodies consistent with double minutes
Adjacent interphase nuclei in panel C for size comparison
60575.describe_en: Composite cytogenetic figure. Interphase FISH (panel A) shows many nuclei containing innumerable scattered and clustered probe signals, a 'fireworks' pattern indicating high-level gene amplification with heterogeneous copy number between cells. Metaphase FISH (panel B) shows the amplified signals dispersed around the chromosomes rather than at a fixed locus, and the corresponding banded metaphase (panel C) shows numerous small double minute chromosomes. Findings are consistent with extrachromosomal MYC amplification in the form of double minutes, a finding associated with complex karyotypes and myelodysplasia-related acute myeloid leukemia and adverse prognosis.

ddx.vs: Chromosomal gain yields only one or two extra discrete signals per nucleus, not innumerable clustered signals with double minutes.
An hsr localizes amplified signals in a single contiguous block on one chromosome, whereas double minutes scatter signals across the metaphase.
A break-apart probe shows one split red/green signal pair per nucleus rather than high-level amplification.

27935.recognize_zh: 視野中多顆大型母細胞，染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質中等量淡藍、幾乎無顆粒，偶有少數細顆粒，旁邊有一顆較成熟的顆粒性前驅細胞；形態符合伴有 CEBPA 突變的急性骨髓性白血病（AML with mutated CEBPA），但診斷須靠分子檢測。
features: Numerous large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio
Round to polygonal nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and one or more small nucleoli
Moderate amounts of pale basophilic, largely agranular cytoplasm; occasional fine granules or small vacuoles
No Auer rods identified in this field
Admixed granulated myeloid precursor, a mature neutrophil, and a small lymphocyte in the background
27935.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of large blasts with moderate to high N:C ratios, round to polygonal nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli, and moderate amounts of pale blue, mostly agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not seen in this field. Scattered granulated myeloid precursors and a mature neutrophil are present. The morphology is that of acute myeloid leukemia without distinctive features; demonstration of a biallelic or in-frame bZIP CEBPA mutation is required for classification as AML with mutated CEBPA.

ddx.vs: Often shows cup-like nuclear invaginations and monocytic differentiation, with cytoplasmic NPM1 by IHC and NPM1 mutation.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and lack MPO and Auer rods, and express TdT/CD19 or cytoplasmic CD3.
Morphologically similar agranular blasts, but MPO is <3% and there is no defining CEBPA mutation.
Monoblasts have abundant grayish cytoplasm, folded nuclei, and nonspecific esterase positivity.
